title: Main Group Behind “No Kings” Overwhelmingly Endorses Van Hollen Over Schumer
content:
Indivisible said that 97% of its chapter leaders support the Maryland Democrat to be the next Senate majority leader.

Support justice-driven, accurate and transparent news — make a quick donation to Truthout today!

Indivisible, one of the organizations behind the “No Kings” movement that brought millions of people into the streets to protest against President Donald Trump, is throwing its support behind Sen. Chris Van Hollen’s bid to be the next Senate majority leader.

In a Monday announcement, Indivisible said that 97% of its chapter leaders nationwide voted to endorse Van Hollen (D-Md.), who last week announced he was challenging current Senate Minority Leader Chuck Schumer (D-NY) to lead Democrats in the upper congressional chamber next year.

Indivisible said Van Hollen won its endorsement because he shared three key priorities with the group: “Ending the war in Iran and the economic pain Americans are feeling at the pump; clawing back funding for ICE and Border Patrol while stopping devastating Medicaid cuts; and using every procedural tool available, including breaking the corrupt Senate filibuster on day one.”

The group also noted some of the high-profile fights Van Hollen has taken up with the Trump administration, such as his decision to meet with Maryland resident Kilmar Abrego after he was unlawfully deported to El Salvador in 2025.

Leah Greenberg, co-executive director of Indivisible, said Van Hollen “represents the kind of leadership we need,” as he is “willing to match the urgency of this moment, make life more affordable, and take on powerful interests.”

Schumer, in contrast, “has become a symbol of the failed leadership and political status quo that voters are ready to move beyond,” Greenberg said.

Surveys of progressive activists released over the last two weeks by Our Revolution and MoveOn have shown an overwhelming desire for new Democratic congressional leadership, particularly in the Senate.

One poll conducted by MoveOn Civic Action found that 82% of MoveOn members who took part in the survey do not support Schumer becoming Senate majority leader.

A poll of over 4,300 progressive activists released by Our Revolution, meanwhile, found that 72% of respondents want a different leader than Schumer.

author: Sharon Zhang
title: Trump: “I Don’t Take Any Responsibility” for Ground Stop That Stranded 1.5M
content:
Trump said the repairs have been needed for 40 years, not noting he’s been president for six of those.

Truthout is a vital news source and a living history of political struggle. If you think our work is valuable, support us with a donation of any size.

President Donald Trump said that he doesn’t “take any responsibility” for the nationwide ground stop for air travel issued by the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) on Friday, instead saying that the crisis was former President Joe Biden’s fault.

“I don’t take any responsibility,” Trump said in remarks to press on Monday, when asked if he feels responsible as president.

“I mean, the only responsibility should be — for 40 years they should have done this. This is a system that’s probably, on average, 50 years old,” he said, adding that he is now asking Congress for more funding. He did not acknowledge that he has served as president for nearly six years during that time.

Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy also blamed “prior administrations” for the issues, without acknowledging that Trump was in charge of one of those prior administrations.

Instead, in a post on Truth Social on Sunday morning, the president blamed Biden. “The Biden Administration was an FAA disaster. Everything they touched turned bad. Big money spent unwisely, making an old and broken system worse than when they began,” Trump wrote.

He echoed Duffy’s calls for Congress to allocate more money to the FAA in response to the ground stop. Democrats in Congress, however, pushed back on the Trump administration’s complaints.

“Let’s look at the facts. Congress approved $12.5 billion for the Department of Transportation to make necessary safety upgrades to our air traffic control system. Fifteen months later, the administration’s obligated $4.3 billion but only spent $1 billion, leaving $8 billion unobligated and $11 billion unspent. Explain to Congress, again, why they need more money?” said Representatives Rick Larsen (D-Washington) and André Carson (D-Indiana), ranking members of the House Committee on Transportation and Subcommittee on Aviation, respectively.

In a response to the Democrats, Duffy has said that the money allocated by Congress is already “all accounted for” and more is needed for a “new network,” which would require “new money to build new software.”

Duffy has said that the issue, which impacted 10,000 flights and stranded roughly 1.5 million travelers, was caused by an infrastructure upgrade that was being done in an unspecified “remote” facility by a contractor, L3Harris, which is also a major military contractor. The contractor was replacing copper wire with fiber optic cable, officials said. This caused a breakdown in communication systems that spiralled across the country, administration officials have claimed, without explaining how.

The union that represents public workers who typically do aviation infrastructure maintenance said that they were not involved in the upgrade, and said that the union has been sidelined in the process of reforming the nation’s air traffic control system.

The GAO warned in September that the speed of the upgrades currently being done under Duffy’s “Brand New Air Traffic Control System” plan is reckless and that the rapid replacement of old technologies would risk causing a major failure. Duffy has touted the FAA’s implementation of an AI-powered routing system, called Strategic Management of Airspace, Routes and Trajectories (SMART), which the administration put into place nationwide just days before the nationwide ground stop.

Experts and members of Congress have indeed acknowledged the need for upgrades to the U.S.’s aviation infrastructure, which is, like many other parts of the U.S.’s infrastructure, in dire need of repairs. The American Society of Civil Engineers gave the aviation sector a D+ grade in its latest report on America’s infrastructure. The report said that bills like the Infrastructure Investment and Jobs Act (IIJA), signed into law by Biden in 2021, have provided some help, but that there is still a massive funding gap of roughly $114 billion over the next decade.

Critics have said that Trump has contributed to the state of aviation infrastructure. At the beginning of his second term, Trump ordered a pause on the disbursement of funding under the IIJA and Inflation Reduction Act of 2022, putting a pause on FAA funding, among other things, from the bills passed under Biden. It’s still unclear how much of that money in total was clawed back or withheld.

Further, the Trump administration has, in some ways, actively worked against aviation safety advancements. One of his first actions in his second term was to eliminate the Department of Homeland Security’s membership in the Aviation Security Advisory Committee. And, in February 2025, the Trump administration fired hundreds of FAA employees amid Elon Musk’s “Department of Government Efficiency” slashes, contributing to shortages in air traffic control staff.

In his first term, Trump released a plan to privatize the air traffic control system. This was vehemently opposed by aviation experts, and the Government Accountability Organization (GAO) found in a report around that time that it would jeopardize safety, and Duffy has shifted away from that plan during Trump’s second term.

Trump was incensed and made an offhand racist remark when he was asked whether he should have focused more on aviation safety during his second term on Monday.

Trump to a Black reporter: "I know you don’t see dirt — but if you’d take a look at the White House, you’d never notice broken windows, obviously, from where you come from."

“Mr. President, what do you say to critics who say you were too focused on D.C. construction projects while our airline systems were crumbling, given the fact that Republicans have been in control?” a reporter asked.

“Well, if you take a look at the White House, it’s flawless,” he responded, before giving a spiel about his various construction projects. As the reporter tried to ask a follow up question, Trump interrupted, saying: “I have a responsibility — oh, you’re so pathetic. Listen, I have a responsibility to make sure the symbol of our country is in decent shape.”

title: Υπόθεση Τοπαλούδη: Στον Άρειο Πάγο ξανά η αίτηση επανεξέτασης του Μανώλη Κούκουρα
content:
Αύριο, Τρίτη 17 Νοεμβρίου 2026, το ΣΤ΄ Ποινικό Τμήμα του Αρείου Πάγου επανέρχεται στην υπόθεση των βιαστών και δολοφόνων της 

Ελένης Τοπαλούδη

, Μανώλη Κούκουρα και Αλεξάνδρου Λούτσαϊ, για να συζητήσει την αίτηση επανεξέτασης που έχει καταθέσει η υπεράσπιση του Κούκουρα, καταδικασθέντος κατά της υπ’ αριθμόν 747/2024 απόφασης του Αρείου Πάγου.




Ο συνήγορος του Κούκουρα

 θεωρεί

 πως στην περίπτωση του πελάτη του μπορεί να εφαρμοστεί το άρθρο 523 του 

Κώδικα

 

Ποινικής

 

Δικονομίας

, το οποίο ορίζει πως ο Άρειος Πάγος επανέρχεται στην υπόθεση αν μια αίτηση αναίρεσης απορρίφθηκε από παραδρομή ως ανυποστήρικτη ή απαράδεκτη, καθώς και αν κάποιος προταθείς λόγος αναίρεσης δεν κρίθηκε καθόλου. Η διαδικασία ξεκινά είτε με αίτηση του αναιρεσείοντα ή του εισαγγελέα του Αρείου Πάγου είτε αυτεπαγγέλτως από το ίδιο το δικαστήριο.




Αυτό σημαίνει πως το δικαστήριο δεν θα δικάσει ξανά την υπόθεση επί της ουσίας και δεν θα κρίνει εκ νέου την ενοχή των Κούκουρα και Λουτσάι. Αυτό που θα εξεταστεί είναι κατά πόσον η απόφαση του Αρείου Πάγου του 2024, με την οποία απορρίφθηκαν οι αιτήσεις αναίρεσης και των δύο καταδικασθέντων, περιέχει νομικά σφάλματα και κατά πόσον η αίτηση επανεξέτασης είναι παραδεκτή.




Μέχρι τώρα, το ανώτατο δικαστήριο έχει απορρίψει τις αιτήσεις αναίρεσης και των δύο δολοφόνων, καθιστώντας τελεσίδικες τις ποινές που είχε επιβάλει το Μικτό Ορκωτό Εφετείο: ισόβια κάθειρξη για ανθρωποκτονία από πρόθεση και 15 έτη κάθειρξη για ομαδικό βιασμό, χωρίς αναγνώριση ελαφρυντικών.




Σήμερα, η υπεράσπιση του Μανώλη Κούκουρα — με συνήγορο τον Χάρη Αμπράζη, ο οποίος τον εκπροσωπεί από το 2020 — επιχειρεί να ανατρέψει την τελεσίδικη κρίση. Την οικογένεια της Ελένης Τοπαλούδη εκπροσωπεί ο Ευάγγελος Γκιουγκής.




Η στρατηγική του Αμπράζη παραμένει η ίδια από το 2020: ο πελάτης του φέρει μικρότερο βαθμό συμμετοχής από τον Αλέξανδρο Λούτσαϊ. Ειδικότερα, προβάλλονται οι εξής ισχυρισμοί:







Ο Κούκουρας είναι αριστερόχειρας, ενώ τα περισσότερα τραύματα στο θύμα προκλήθηκαν από δεξιόχειρα δράστη.




Υποστηρίζεται ότι τα αποτυπώματα στο σίδερο σιδερώματος — το όργανο της επίθεσης — ανήκουν αποκλειστικά στον Λούτσαϊ.




Ο Κούκουρας παραδέχεται μόνον ένα «δυνατό χτύπημα», αλλά αρνείται τη συμμετοχή του στη μεταφορά του θύματος στη θάλασσα και σε οποιαδήποτε άλλη ενέργεια.




Ίχνη αίματος και οπτικοακουστικό υλικό: Επικαλείται ότι ίχνη αίματος βρέθηκαν μόνο στα παπούτσια του Λούτσαϊ και ότι οπτικοακουστικό υλικό δεν αξιολογήθηκε ορθά.







Τόσο η Εισαγγελεία όσο και ο συνήγορος της οικογένειας ζητούν την απόρριψη της αίτησης. Ειδικότερα, ο κ. Γκουγκής εξηγεί πως ο θάνατος δεν επήλθε από την χρήση του ηλεκτρικού σίδερου ούτε από τα τραύματα, αλλά από πνιγμό, οπότε δεν συνιστάται λόγος περαιτέρω εξέτασης των επιχειρημάτων της υπεράσπισης.




Δεδομένου ότι πρόκειται για το «έσχατο ένδικο μέσο» στο πλαίσιο της ελληνικής έννομης τάξης, εάν το δικαστήριο κρίνει την αίτηση απαράδεκτη ή αβάσιμη, η υπόθεση θα κλείσει οριστικά σε επίπεδο αναίρεσης.







Σοφία Σπυριδωνίδη

title: Animal Rising Disrupts National Pig Awards in Central London Following Campaigner Arrests
content:
Animal Rising campaigners disrupted the National Pig Awards at the Royal Lancaster Hotel in central London this evening (16 November), while protesters outside blocked the main entrance. Police were called to the venue.

Despite enhanced security, six campaigners reached the event and were subsequently apprehended before being ejected from the hotel at approximately 7 pm. Around 70 protesters gathered outside as attendees arrived, holding placards reading “Free Luna” and “End Factory Farming”.

The group publicly declared its intention to shut down the awards last week, calling for Red Court, a pig factory farm in Suffolk, to release Luna, a mother pig whose life of confinement was filmed continuously for over a month by Animal Rising earlier this year. [1]

The investigation documented squalid conditions and illegal piglet thumping on the Red Tractor Assured farm. [2] Over 40,000 people have since signed a petition calling for Luna’s release to a sanctuary. [3]

The group filmed Luna confined in a narrow farrowing crate for five weeks, unable to turn around or take more than a step forward. A sanctuary has since offered her a home for the rest of her life. [4]

Red Court confirmed last week that Luna is once again in a farrowing crate. If the farm refuses to release her, she will remain there for approximately another month, confined with her newborn piglets, before she is removed and re-inseminated.

The farm has also rejected a proposed £5,000 donation to You Are Not Alone, an East Anglian charity supporting farmers’ mental health, in exchange for Luna’s release. [5]

Earlier today, Animal Rising announced that a third campaigner, Michelle Farnham, had been arrested on suspicion of burglary following the open rescue of three piglets (Leila, Nova and Maia) from Red Court.

Before the rescue, Animal Rising reported serious welfare concerns at the farm to the police, RSPCA and Animal and Plant Health Agency (APHA).

APHA, the body responsible for enforcing farmed animal welfare, informed Animal Rising that the farm’s conditions, including the illegal thumping of a piglet, were normal.

Farnham attended Stoke Newington Police Station at 10 am this morning. Her fellow rescuers, Thomas Cusick and Liam Shaughnessy, had previously reported themselves to the police and been arrested. [6]

Farnham, 26, Animal Rising’s Campaign Lead, attracted national attention in September when she spent 21 days and nights locked in a farrowing crate in Trafalgar Square, highlighting Luna’s story and the suffering of animals in factory farms. High-profile visitors included Chris Packham and Green MP Adrian Ramsay. [7]

Animal Rising is campaigning for a government commitment to end UK factory farming by 2040.

author: Gaurav Kumar
title: How India’s Cockroach movement maintains nonviolent discipline
content:
This article 

How India’s Cockroach movement maintains nonviolent discipline

 was originally published by 

Waging Nonviolence

.







On Nov. 7, the eve of Diwali, the Hindu festival of lights, the leaders of the Cockroach Janta Party, or CJP, including founder Abhijeet Dipke, were not at home. They were marching in Kochi, a port city in the southern state of Kerala, nearly 1,300 miles from Delhi. 




The march echoed the two demands the movement had been shouting in Delhi’s streets since the first week of October: Scrap the nationwide recheck of voter rolls that began in June 2025, and sack the chief election commissioner, Gyanesh Kumar. 




The Cockroach movement came into being in May of this year and won its first victory in July, pushing India’s education minister out of office over a leaked national medical entrance exam. The open question then was whether 

a movement with no one leader and no office

 would still be around after winning its first fight. It is, and while it still has no office, it has picked a much bigger fight. Not an exam this time, but the vote itself.




The Election Commission, which runs India’s elections, is rechecking every one of India’s nearly one billion voters. In the name of clearing the rolls of the dead, the duplicated, people who have moved and what its 

June 2025 order

 called “foreign illegal immigrants,” it has 

purged more than 130 million

 voters. In Delhi alone, the cleanup has knocked 4.76 million people, nearly a third of the city’s electorate, off the voter list. 










Sign Up for our Newsletter




We’ll send you a weekly email with the latest articles.
































































 










Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s Hindu nationalist Bharatiya Janata Party, or BJP, strongly backs the recheck, saying that it’s necessary to strike undocumented migrants from neighboring Bangladesh, particularly Muslims, who have slipped onto the rolls. Amit Shah, Modi’s home minister and most powerful lieutenant, has defended the recheck as a way to “detect, delete, deport” what he calls infiltrators. 

But critics charge

 that the rolls are being manipulated to benefit the BJP. They say the recheck shifts the burden of proof onto voters, and that the people least likely to have the required documents are the ones being dropped. 




Human Rights Watch found

 that the purge has disproportionately affected women, the poor and Muslims; in one area of West Bengal that is nine percent Muslim, more than 92 percent of those deleted were Muslim. 

Opposition leaders

 have called the recheck a backdoor version of the National Register of Citizens, a citizenship list the BJP promised in 2019 to extend across India.




Presiding over it all is Kumar, whose commission both referees India’s elections and runs the recheck. He was handpicked by Modi in February 2025 under a new law giving Modi more power over the selection, in a decision announced late at night over the written dissent of opposition leader Rahul Gandhi.




In late September, the national daily 

The Indian Express

 

reported

 that two of the election commission’s three members, Sukhbir Singh Sandhu and Vivek Joshi, had objected on record at least 14 times in 10 months to decisions and orders tied to the recheck that they say were issued in the commission’s name without their knowledge. (In an official statement, the commission maintained that all of its decisions on the recheck were unanimous.) 




Previous Coverage

 

What India’s Cockroach Party won — and what’s next




The Cockroach movement, which had been pressuring the government since July over broken promises, responded by calling Kumar the biggest threat to India’s democracy and giving him 48 hours to resign.




When Kumar ignored the movement’s deadline, it took to the streets of Delhi and other cities on Oct. 2, the birthday of Mahatma Gandhi, who led India’s nonviolent struggle for independence.




Unlike most Indian police forces, Delhi’s police do not answer to the city’s elected government but to the federal Home Ministry, run by Shah. It answered the protests the way it did in July, only harder. On Oct. 10 police detained more than 2,000 people in Delhi, opposition leaders and journalists among them, while about 600 were detained in Mumbai, India’s financial capital, and mobile internet went dark in the heart of Delhi.




Two days later

, Jantar Mantar — a square just a short walk from Parliament that has been Delhi’s main protest site for decades and was occupied by the movement for five weeks this summer — was struck off the list of places where protest is allowed. Two of the movement’s leaders, Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka, walked into Jantar Mantar with the national flag the next day and were arrested. They were jailed for a week for breaking a peace bond and still face criminal charges. 




Through all of this, the protests have stayed nonviolent and they have spread well beyond Delhi. In Kochi, hundreds of people marched behind the actor and activist Prakash Raj under the banner “Jantar Mantar @ Kochi.”




I spoke with Ratna Singh, who leads the CJP’s legal team, over a series of WhatsApp voice calls in early November, about how the movement holds its nonviolent line under this much pressure, and what comes next.




Ratna Singh (left) and Saurav Das (right) exit court proceedings on Aug. 18, 2026 in Delhi. (Ishant Chauhan/Hindustan Times via Getty Images)




This interview was conducted in Hindi and has been translated and edited for length and clarity.




Your movement started over an exam. Now it’s about the vote. Who are you really fighting, the Election Commission or Modi?




It’s the same fight. We can’t question how an election is run without questioning the government that runs it. Let’s stop pretending these are separate things.




The BJP’s attitude is, “You voted, now shut up and obey.” That’s democratic tyranny. Citizens have every right to check the rolls, expose manipulation and ask for complete transparency.




What really gets me is how state media treats the BJP as if it were the nation. The government cannot claim to speak for the entire country. Modi is the prime minister, but Indian democracy belongs to its citizens.




People came out in October because they’d had enough of that arrogance. We’re not begging for crumbs. We want accountability, and we’ll take it.




The crackdown came fast. How do you get people ready for that, and keep them nonviolent when the police move in?




We brief everyone before every march: no panic, no retaliation. When police charge or bring out detention buses, our instruction is to sit down on the pavement immediately. Sitting down takes away their excuse to claim we were rushing them or inciting a riot.




It forces the police to physically carry people away one by one, which slows them down and exposes their aggression on camera. Nonviolence here isn’t passive; it’s an active tactic to strip the state of its excuses.




The state’s favorite trick is to change the story. People are out there over stolen elections, and suddenly the debate is about unlawful assembly and traffic permits. That’s deliberate. It keeps the government away from real scrutiny.




I tell people to remain disciplined and understand their legal rights. That does not mean they should stop questioning the authorities. We can remain peaceful while continuing to challenge the government.




There’s no single leader. So, who keeps the discipline?




Indian politics is sick with hero worship, and the BJP is the worst case. Everything revolves around the cult of Modi: the propaganda, the policy, the state machinery. That’s not strength. That’s a single point of failure. We’re not going to build another political god. 




A real movement runs on shared anger and a clear strategy, not on waiting for one boss to give orders. The movement depends on people understanding its objectives and taking responsibility for their actions. We don’t need one person making every decision.




In large, leaderless crowds, how do you stop someone from throwing stones or provoking violence?




The state’s oldest trick is sending in provocateurs to throw a stone, turn a march violent and justify a crackdown. We deploy trained marshals and experienced volunteers across the crowd. The moment someone starts acting aggressively or picks up a projectile, our volunteers immediately surround that person, isolate them and calm the crowd down. We make it clear: Anyone inciting violence is working for the regime, not the movement.




Mobile internet was shut down in central Delhi during the protests. How do you coordinate when you’re offline?




You can’t rely solely on WhatsApp or social media when you’re fighting a state that controls the kill switch. We operate on a decentralized structure. We use pre-agreed physical contact points, runner systems and offline mesh networks to pass instructions.




Small local teams know their primary and secondary assembly spots in advance. If the internet goes dark, the plan doesn’t change. Everyone knows where to be and what their role is.




Critics say you’re being provocative on purpose. Are you?




Absolutely. That’s the whole point of resistance. If you’re not threatening the status quo, you’re just putting on a show for the regime.




“Provocative” is what people in power call you when they’re losing their grip on citizens. They want polite dissent with no teeth, petitions they can drop straight in the bin.




But there’s a huge line between physical violence and hard political confrontation. And the BJP built its empire on ruthless political violence. It has no right to lecture its victims about manners. If asking questions provokes them, it just shows how long they’ve been coddled.




The government says the mass detentions were just routine law and order.




That’s a pathetic, cowardly excuse. The minute the state’s legitimacy is questioned, it hides behind police batons and calls it public safety.




Look at the double standard. The BJP can shut down whole cities for its own rallies, and that’s national pride. Ordinary citizens gather to question the government, and suddenly they’re a national security threat.




If our accusations are false, why hide the data and the sources? If the system isn’t rigged, prove it. Sending in police boots to crush dissent isn’t governance. It’s state terror. And attacking Modi is a democratic duty, not treason.




Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka spent a week in Tihar jail over a peace bond, and they’re still facing charges. What’s the point of all this legal pressure?




It’s judicial harassment. The repeated summonses and legal cases put enormous pressure on activists and their families. Even when a protest is peaceful, people have to spend time and money dealing with these cases. We believe the legal process is being used to discourage people from continuing the movement.




How does your legal team handle thousands of detentions in a single day?




It’s a war of attrition. We have a network of volunteer lawyers stationed across different police stations and magistrate courts in the city. As soon as a detention bus leaves, our ground volunteers send the vehicle number and station location through our backup channels.




Lawyers arrive before the buses to monitor treatment, track names and draft bail bonds on the spot. They want to wear us down with paperwork and legal costs, but our legal network works 24/7 to make sure no activist is left behind.




Jantar Mantar is now closed to protest. What does that say about Modi’s government?




This blows apart Modi’s whole international act. He travels the world selling India as the “Mother of Democracy,” and at home he runs a police state that chokes basic speech.




Jantar Mantar was set aside for people to protest, not for parades the state approves of. When they use red tape to outlaw political opposition, that’s not regulation. That’s totalitarian control.




If the state only allows protests that pose no risk to it, democracy is already dead. What’s left is a show.




What has kept people coming back for four months, with all this pressure?




The core crime hasn’t gone away.




The BJP survives on short attention spans. Every 72 hours there’s a new crisis or another distraction pitting Hindus against Muslims to flood the news, and then they wait for people to forget.




But electoral fraud and captured institutions don’t disappear just because the TV channels move on. 




Women have been at the front of these protests. What does that change?




It wrecks the BJP’s gender washing. They use women as props in their campaign ads. Real empowerment is women on the street standing up to state power.




When a woman stands up and calls out Modi’s regime, that’s direct political action. You can’t praise women as obedient voters in your speeches and then send riot police after them the moment they turn against you.
















Support Us




Waging Nonviolence depends on reader support. Make a donation today!




Donate













What did the recent gathering in Kochi show you?




It kills the regime’s line that this is a tantrum by Delhi elites.




Electoral corruption is a national disease. The BJP badly wants every protest to look local, because a united, nationwide resistance threatens its grip on power.




Kochi shows it’s crossing state lines. Modi’s government can’t contain this as a local disturbance anymore. The anger is spreading, and the state can’t arrest an entire country.




People have until Nov. 25 to file objections and corrections to the recheck, and the final list comes out on Dec. 22. If millions are still missing, is that the end of it?




Right now, it’s maximum pressure through Nov. 25 and Dec. 22. We won’t let the state use those dates as a blanket to smother the questions about the rolls.




Will the CJP run for office in the 2027 state elections or the 2029 general election?




It’s a real strategic option. But turning into just another party is a trap. If we end up copying the BJP’s centralization, its high handedness, its autocratic habits, then the whole struggle has failed.




The Modi regime isn’t invincible. Its dominance is an illusion kept alive by fear. But empty slogans against Modi won’t do it. You need an aggressive alternative that takes apart the power structure.




The people are sovereign, not Narendra Modi. The BJP has no divine right to rule. If we get on the ballot, it’ll be to smash this culture of unchecked power, not to swap one dictator for another. We’re not here to cause a temporary disturbance. We’re here to bring the political establishment to its knees.




This article 

How India’s Cockroach movement maintains nonviolent discipline

 was originally published by 

Waging Nonviolence

.

title: Συγκέντρωση αλληλεγγύης για τη σύλληψη στις 30/10/24, Πέμπτη 19/11 στις 9:00 στα δικαστήρια Θεσσαλονίκης
content:
Την Πέμπτη 19/11 συνεχίζεται η δίκη της σύλληψης στις 30/10/2024, που ξεκίνησε την Τετάρτη 11/11. Δύο ημέρες μετά τους ξυλοδαρμούς και τις συλλήψεις από την ομάδα ΔΡΑΣΗ στο πάρκο εργατικού κέντρου στις 28/10/2024, πραγματοποιείται πορεία αλληλεγγύης στην περιοχή. Με το τέλος της πορείας πραγματοποιούνται μικρής έκτασης συμπλοκές με την αστυνομία. Μετά από λίγη ώρα δυνάμεις της αστυνομίας κατεβαίνουν στην Γκαρμπολά και πραγματοποιούν επιθέσεις σε κόσμο που βρίσκεται στην περιοχή. Έπειτα από αντεγκλήσεις με κόσμο που βρίσκεται σε κατάστημα στον πεζόδρομο, η αστυνομία επιτίθεται ρίχνοντας δακρυγόνο μέσα στο μαγαζί, χτυπώντας συγκεντρωμένους και σπάζοντας τραπέζια. Ταυτόχρονα εξαπολύει κυνηγητό σε κόσμο που προσπαθούσε να ξεφύγει από τα δακρυγόνα και πραγματοποιείται μία σύλληψη ατόμου που δεν πρόλαβε να μπει σε κατάστημα στην Τοσίτσα για να προστατευτεί.




Ολόκληρο το ρεπορτάζ για τα δύο περιστατικά εδώ: 

https://www.facebook.com/infolibregr/posts/pfbid02q9HH4eLyWUv4aFkEBFGiPMJJepUmTK75Uma39mvGUB8dtq3tiYQXno8hd7Rw1nTwl




Το κάλεσμα για την Πέμπτη 19/11:




ΕΝΗΜΕΡΩΣΗ ΑΠΟ ΤΗΝ ΠΡΩΤΗ ΔΙΚΑΣΙΜΟ ΚΑΙ ΚΑΛΕΣΜΑ ΣΕ ΣΥΓΚΕΝΤΡΩΣΗ ΑΛΛΗΛΕΓΓΥΗΣ ΣΤΑ ΔΙΚΑΣΤΗΡΙΑ ΘΕΣΣΑΛΟΝΙΚΗΣ ΣΤΙΣ 19/11/26




Στις 11/11/26 εκδικάζονταν δύο υποθέσεις, η μία από τις 28/10/24 και η άλλη από 30/10/24. Η πρώτη αφορούσε τον ξυλοδαρμό και τις συλλήψεις κόσμου σε τυχαίο έλεγχο της ομάδας ΔΡΑΣΗ στο πάρκο του ΕΚΘ και η δεύτερη το πογκρόμ των δυνάμεων καταστολής μετά τη λήξη της πορείας που ακολούθησε δύο μέρες αργότερα (Περισσσότερα για το ιστορικό εδω: 

https://athens.indymedia.org/post/1643142/

). Η πρώτη υπόθεση πήρε αναβολή επειδή έλειπαν οι μάρτυρες κατηγορίας, ενώ η δεύτερη ξεκίνησε. Βασική επιδίωξη της Αστυνομικής διέυθυνσης Θεσ/νίκης ήταν να μην εκδικαστούν οι δύο υποθέσεις μαζί, μη τυχόν και αναδειχθεί σε σερί ακροαματικών διαδικασιών το επίπεδο αυθαιρεσίας στο οποίο επιχειρεί το σώμα γενικότερα και συγκεκριμένα η ομάδα ΔΡΑΣΗ (που πραγματοποίησε όλες τις συλλήψεις του διημέρου). Η ΕΛ.ΑΣ λοιπόν κατάφερε να απομπλέξει τις δύο υποθέσεις, όσον αφορά την έδρα και την μέρα εκδίκασης. Σχετικά με το δικαστήριο που αφορά τις συλλήψεις μετά την πορεία, κατέθεσε ο μάρτυρας κατηγορίας ενώ η έδρα διέκοψε για την Πέμπτη 

(19/11/26 στις 9:00)

 όπου και θα συνεχιστεί με τις καταθέσεις των μαρτύρων υπεράσπισης, των κατηγορούμενων και την ολοκλήρωση της διαδικασίας.




Η συγκέντρωση αλληλεγγύης πλαισιώθηκε από 50 συντρόφια, παρέμεινε μέχρι το τέλος μπροστά από την είσοδο και εξέθεσε εκ νέου το παράλογο του ιδεολογικού face-control που εφαρμόζει η ΕΛ.ΑΣ τους τελευταίους μήνες στα δικαστήρια της Θεσ/νίκης. Δικαστική αστυνομία, ΜΑΤ, ασφαλίτες και αξιωματικοί υπηρεσίας καθόντουσαν μπροστά στην είσοδο των δικαστηρίων επί ώρες αφήνοντας να περνάνε εκατοντάδες άνθρωποι και απαγορεύοντας επί της ουσίας την είσοδο στο κτήριο σε αλληλέγγυο κόσμο. Στα πλαίσια αυτής της ευφάνταστης κατασταλτικής παράνοιας, απαγόρευαν την είσοδο μέχρι και λίγο πριν την έναρξη της δίκης στους μάρτυρες υπεράσπισης, ενώ κοντοστάθηκαν ακόμα και σε συγγενείς. Οι επικεφαλείς τους ανέφεραν για ακόμη μια φορά μια προφορική εντολή της προισταμένης εισαγγελέως των δικαστηρίων. Έγινε μια απόπειρα επικοινωνίας δικηγόρων μαζί της για να αποσαφηνιστεί περί τίνος πρόκειται, ωστόσο αυτό δε κατέστη εφικτό από πλευράς της. Όποια και αν είναι αυτή η προφορική εντολή 

(αποκλείεται όντως αυτό το πράγμα να έχει τη μορφή γραπτής αποτύπωσης), από όποια διαχρονική λίστα επιθυμιών του απρόσωπου κρατικού αυταρχισμού και αν έχει προκύψει και ασχέτως του πως εξειδικεύεται, το μόνο σίγουρο είναι ότι στοχεύει στην αποσυσπείρωση του κόσμου, την απονοηματοδότηση της πολιτικής δίκης και την τραμπούκα. Η ξεφτίλα του να μπαίνουν εκατοντάδες άνθρωποι μέσα στα δικαστήρια ενώ ο αλληλέγγυος κόσμος όχι, έληξε μόνο όταν ξεκίνησε η δίκη, με τα συντρόφια να γεμίζουν την αίθουσα μετά από πολλές ώρες επίμονης διεκδίκησης του αυτονόητου. Την Πέμπτη στις 19/11/26 θα συνεχιστεί η δίκη που αφορά τις συλλήψεις στην Τοσίτσα και καλούμε τον κόσμο του αγώνα να στηρίξει με την παρουσία του σε αυτό όπως και σε όσα δικαστήρια έπονται το επόμενο χρονικό διάστημα απλώνοντας μια ασπίδα προστασίας γύρω από τα όποια διωκόμενα συντρόφια, τα κεκτημένα και τα επίδικα του αγώνα. Απέναντι στις ανεξάντλητες κατασταλτικές εφεδρείες του κρατικού μηχανισμού και τις διάφορες θεσμικές εκδοχές θέσπισης ιδιώνυμων, το μόνο που έχουμε είναι ο ένας την άλλη. Κόντρα σε λογικές ιδιώτευσης και ανάθεσης, αντιπροτάσουμε τη δέσμευση και τη συντροφικότητα. 

Όσα είπαμε παλιότερα ισχύουν: Ποτέ κανένας μόνος στα χέρια του κράτους.




ΑΛΛΗΛΕΓΓΥΗ ΣΕ ΟΣΑ ΣΥΝΤΡΟΦΙΑ ΔΙΩΚΟΝΤΑΙ ΓΙΑ ΤΗΝ ΠΟΛΙΤΙΚΗ ΤΟΥΣ ΔΡΑΣΗ




Η ΑΛΛΗΛΕΓΓΥΗ ΕΙΝΑΙ ΤΟ ΟΠΛΟ ΜΑΣ

author: Lilli Akpaleeapik
title: Various Molson, Coors beer brands under nationwide recall
content:
A national food recall for several brands of beer due to “metal contamination” does not affect products on Nunavut’s beer and wine store shelves, the Finance Department announced Friday.




The recall was first announced Nov. 9 due to the possible presence of small pieces of metal inside the affected products.




Various beers produced by Molson Coors Beverage Co. are affected, including Coors Light, Molson Canadian and Blue Moon Belgian-Style Wheat Ale.




The only non-alcoholic beverages on the list are six- and 24-packs of Non-Alcoholic Blue Moon Belgian-Style Wheat Ale.




The exact items, including packaging and UPC codes, 

can be found

 on the Canadian Health Inspection Agency website.




None of the alcoholic beverages listed are in the Nunavut Liquor and Cannabis Commission’s current inventory, according to the announcement from the Finance Department.




Non-alcoholic beers are available in grocery stores. Consumers are urged not to sell, distribute or drink products included on the list.

title: Άφησαν το ιστορικό κτήριο Γκίνη στο Πολυτεχνείο επίτηδες να σαπίσει (Βίντεο)
content:
Άφησαν το ιστορικό κτήριο Γκίνη στο Πολυτεχνείο επίτηδες να σαπίσει (Βίντεο)




Πρωινό Κυριακής 15 Νοέμβρη 2022. Ο τροχός κόβει τα κάγκελα της οχύρωσης ενάντια στους ανθρώπους μέσα στο ιστορικό κτήριο Γκίνη στο κάτω 

Πολυτεχνείο

. Ένα νεκρό κτήριο, χωρίς ζωή, σφραγισμένο και παρατημένο επί της ουσίας από τις 15 Μαρτίου του 2020 να σαπίζει μέρα με τη μέρα.







Νεκρά ζώα, τοίχοι και ταβάνια που καταρρέουν, στοιβαγμένα μπάζα, σπασμένες πόρτες από την εισβολή της αστυνομίας πριν από 6.5 χρόνια και η πλήρης απουσία ζωής.




Εκεί που κάποτε στεκόταν το πιο αξιοποιημένο και ζωντανό κτήριο μέσα στο παρατημένο και φθαρμένο κάτω Πολυτεχνείο, εκεί που όχι και τόσα πολλά χρόνια πριν τα κοινωνικά, φοιτητικά και ταξικά κινήματα επί σχεδόν μισό αιώνα έδιναν και έπαιρναν ζωή σε αυτόν τον τόπο συνάντησης μέσα από πολιτικές ζυμώσεις, ανταλλαγή απόψεων, συνελεύσεις και εκδηλώσεις, εκεί που λίγο μετά τα μεσάνυχτα της Πέμπτης 17 Νοέμβρη το 1973 είχαν συγκεντρωθεί εκατοντάδες άτομα, φοιτητές/τριες εργαζόμενοι/ες και άνεργοι/ες κάθε πολιτικής απόχρωσης στην πρώτη συνέλευση της εξέγερσης του Πολυτεχνείου.




Κι αυτό ακριβώς είναι που φοβούνται. Αυτό που τους φοβίζει και θέλουν να θάψουν μέσα στα ερείπια είναι το ίδιο το περιεχόμενο, τον ίδιο τον συμβολισμό που φέρουν και όχι τα ίδια τα ντουβάρια ενός κτηρίου. Για αυτό και τα προορίζουν για άλλη χρήση και σκοπούς, βιβλιοθήκη, καφετέρια, μουσείο και άλλα τέτοια «πιασάρικα» τεχνάσματα που απευθύνονται στον μέσο τηλεθεατή και αναγνώστη που καταναλώνει ειδήσεις. Η αλλαγή χρήσης των κτηρίων είναι το «κλειδί».




Τι ακριβώς προβλέπει όμως η ανάπλαση του Κτιρίου Γκίνη;




Όπως χαρακτηριστικά αναφέρει η σχετική ανακοίνωση της Κατάληψης Γκίνη “Μιχάλης Καλτεζάς”, η εξαγγελθείσα δωρεά βασίζεται σε μελέτη που παρουσιάστηκε τον Ιούλιο του 2021 (ένα χρόνο μετά το αδικαιολόγητο σφράγισμα του κτιρίου από την Πρυτανική αρχή) ως σχέδιο «ανάπλασης» του κτηρίου Γκίνη, εκφράζοντας κυρίως πολιτικές επιδιώξεις. Ενώ επικοινωνείται ως “άνοιγμα” προς την κοινωνία της πόλης και ως ανάπτυξη ενός κόμβου πολιτισμού, τεχνολογίας και καινοτομίας, στην πραγματικότητα απευθύνεται σε μια μικρή ομάδα ακαδημαϊκών με οικονομικά συμφέροντα, σε επενδυτές και σε τουρίστες. Οι πολιτιστικές δραστηριότητες, δε, περιορίζονται σε ελάχιστο χώρο, με μοναδική αναφορά στη θεατρική ομάδα του ΕΜΠ που τοποθετείται στο υπόγειο. Το ισόγειο του κτιρίου Γκίνη, προορίζεται ως «χώρος συνάντησης» για την κοινωνία, όμως οι λειτουργίες του περιλαμβάνουν εμπορικές δραστηριότητες, όπως καφετέρια και βιβλιοπωλείο, καθώς και χώρους «τεχνολογιών αιχμής», δραστηριότητες που συνδέονται αναπόφευκτα με αυξημένα μέτρα φύλαξης, τον περιορισμό της ελεύθερης πρόσβασης και την απομάκρυνση από τον ανοιχτό και δημόσιο χαρακτήρα. Ένα πολύ μεγάλο μέρος του κτιρίου επανασχεδιάζεται ως “μουσείο τεχνολογίας”, “μουσείο Γκίνη” και “χώρος περιοδικών εκθέσεων”, με σαφή στόχευση σε τουριστικές εισροές. Τα 4 από τα 5 μεγάλα αμφιθέατρα μετατρέπονται σε συνεδριακό χώρο, ενώ το 5ο αμφιθέατρο μετατρέπεται σε κυριλέ εστιατόριο με γυάλινη οροφή και roof-garden, προοριζόμενο για πλούσιους τουρίστες, επιχειρηματίες και την ακαδημαϊκή ελίτ.




Εδώ και καιρό πανεπιστημιακές συλλογικότητες, σύλλογοι φοιτητριών και εργαζομένων καταγγέλλουν τη συστηματική υποχρηματοδότηση και υποστελέχωση των εκπαιδευτικών υποδομών, η οποία ξεκίνησε την εποχή των μνημονίων και συνεχίζεται μέχρι και σήμερα, με προφανείς επιπτώσεις στην ποιότητα σπουδών των φοιτητριών, στην ένταση των ταξικών φραγμών, στις πενιχρές αμοιβές των ερευνητών, δημιουργώντας ακόμα και προβλήματα ασφάλειας λόγω ελλιπούς συντήρησης κτιρίων και αιθουσών. Η απάντηση του κράτους σε όλα αυτά είναι η προώθηση των ιδιωτικών χορηγιών, ο προσανατολισμός της εκπαίδευσης και της έρευνας στην ιδιωτική κερδοφορία και την πολεμική βιομηχανία. Η ανάπλαση του κτιρίου Γκίνη εντάσσεται στην παραπάνω λογική καθώς προβλέπει την φιλοξενία εκθέσεων και εκδηλώσεων οργανισμων ‘’εξωτερικών συνεργατών του ΕΜΠ’’, δηλαδή εταιρειών όπως η ισραηλινή πολεμική βιομηχανια INTRACOM DEFENSE, η Motor Oil, οι εφοπλιστικες Laskaridis και DNV, κα.




Σε αυτο το πλαίσιο, οι 4 συστημικές τράπεζες (Αlpha, Eurobank, Πειραιώς, Εθνική), επιδιώκουν με αυτήν τη δωρεά να καλλιεργήσουν ένα κοινωνικά ευαίσθητο προφίλ, καλώντας μας να ξεχάσουμε τους δεκάδες χιλιάδες πλειστηριασμούς 1ης κατοικίας που έχουν πραγματοποιήσει, την οικονομική ενίσχυση δεκάδων δισεκατομμυρίων που έχουν λάβει από τα κρατικά έσοδα από το 2008 και μετά, τις εξωφρενικές χρεώσεις που επιβάλλουν σε μια σειρά υπηρεσιών και δανείων.

author: Hudson Hongo
title: Donate Equity to Support Digital Rights: Stocks, DAFs, and Giving
content:
Do the holidays have you thinking about how you can support your favorite nonprofit?

For 35 years, the Electronic Frontier Foundation has been advancing our digital rights, including defending security researchers, encrypting the web, and fighting illegal surveillance. Donating equity to EFF can help support this important work.

Perhaps your family has taken advantage of the new tax law around giving by creating a Donor-Advised Fund.

Perhaps your employer has gone public and you now own stock.

Perhaps you’ve seen some of EFF’s recent successes and thought, Man, imagine what they could do with more.

A gift of equity can help your contribution go farther and offer tax savings. When you donate appreciated stock, you avoid paying capital gains tax on any increase in its value. You also receive a charitable income tax deduction for the fair market value of appreciated stock on the date it is transferred. Also, more and more companies are offering gift-matching programs that can double your impact at no additional cost.

If you have owned the stock for less than a year, your gift will not qualify for all of these potential tax advantages. And gifts of appreciated stock are fully deductible—up to a maximum of 30% of your adjusted gross income. Please check with your accountant or tax advisor regarding your particular tax status.

We have helpful information here to facilitate the transfer of securities. Please email us if you have any questions. And let us know in advance if you are transferring securities. We’ll need to know the amount and type of shares that you will be donating in order to provide a tax receipt.

As a 501(c)(3) organization, EFF can also receive distributions through your Donor-Advised Fund (DAF), including one-time gifts or recurring donations. Simply inform your DAF provider you would like to make a gift to: Electronic Frontier Foundation (EIN 04-3091431) 815 Eddy Street San Francisco, CA 94109 Please note that many DAF providers do not provide the donor’s name to the recipient organization. If you would like to be recognized for your gift, let us know the amount of the gift and the fund name. And due to IRS regulations, we may not be able to provide a thank you gift in line with your giving level. The DAF provider is responsible for your tax receipt.

The rules that govern technology shape our freedom. Help us write those rules today!

author: Unknown
title: Agricoltori e studenti: un dibattito in università sui temi del carovita, della PAC, delle mobilitazioni sociali
content:
A partire dall’introduzione al dibattito 

Agricoltori e studenti: un’unica terra

, riportiamo qui i punti toccati e invitiamo a riascoltare gli interventi contenuti nel video allegato. 







Un incontro tra agricoltori e studenti per condividere esperienze e individuare prospettive comuni contro il carovita.




Prima di iniziare, faremo una breve introduzione per presentarvi gli ospiti, presenti per la prima volta all’Università di Torino e a Palazzo Nuovo: Gabriele Ponzano, allevatore e agricoltore ad Alessandria, Samantha Sonaglio, allevatrice di bovini di razza francese, anche lei in provincia di Alessandria, e Andrea Maggi, risicoltore nel Vercellese. Invece, dal lato della moderazione e per aiutarci a dare un quadro al dibattito, nonché discutere del perché ci troviamo qui insieme proprio in questo periodo, Andrea di 

Italia in piazza 17.




Sia Gabriele che Samantha fanno parte dell’associazione 

Agricoltori Autonomi Italiani

, che è aderente a un’associazione ancora più grande che si chiama 

COAPI

, Coordinamento Agricoltori e Pescatori italiani.




Questa introduzione si concentra sulle motivazioni che hanno portato alla nascita di queste associazioni nel 2024, perché se oggi attenzioniamo quelle che sono le proteste in corso è importante anche tracciare la storia di queste realtà e delle mobilitazioni degli agricoltori – le cosiddette “rivolte dei trattori” o “mobilitazioni dei trattori”.




Sono associazioni, le loro, che nascono nel 2024. In quel periodo avrete tutti sentito parlare dei “trattori”, attivi anche qui a Torino con vari presidi, ai quali avevamo partecipato insieme ad altri compagni e compagne che avevano seguito queste mobilitazioni. In particolare a Febbraio a Torino Sud, con più di 300 trattori per 5-6 giorni in protesta.







Sostanzialmente i temi che venivano portati già allora nel dibattito pubblico erano quelli di una produzione sottocosto a livello italiano sostanzialmente per tutte le aziende agricole, anche quelle medio-grandi, con la conseguente difficoltà di arrivare a coprire le spese di produzione ed assicurarsi un margine minimo di guadagno.




Il sistema attuale sta infatti andando a schiacciare anche le aziende storicamente più integrate nella produzione capitalistica, quindi con una produzione su vasta scala e inserite nella GDO (grande distribuzione organizzata): anche questi soggetti all’oggi vivono la fine del vantaggio economico di cui hanno potuto godere nel tempo. Questo a causa dell’apertura dei mercati e delle politiche agricole europee sempre più concentrate verso la grande e grandissima produzione.




Ma, tra gli altri temi portati allora, c’era anche quello della mancanza di rappresentanza.




Quindi la frattura che si è creata nel 2024 con i sindacati agricoli, Coldiretti e non solo, ha portato alla creazione di queste nuove associazioni: un modo, come gli ospiti ci racconteranno meglio, per  dare voce direttamente alle proprie rivendicazioni di agricoltrici e agricoltori.I sindacati nel tempo si sono trasformati da enti di supporto alle istanze di chi lavora e di chi produce a CAF territoriali che sostanzialmente aiutano i produttori solo dal punto di vista burocratico. Anche la burocrazia è sicuramente un tema importante, soprattutto per quanto riguarda i sussidi europei ma anche, ad esempio, per le normative sanitarie.




Anche oggi, le aziende che si stanno mobilitando in tutta Italia sono sia relativamente piccole che di media dimensione, come ad esempio quella di Andrea che si estende per 116 ettari. 

Nel complesso non si tratta di piccoli produttori tagliati fuori dal mercato, ma è il mercato stesso che è arrivato a una crisi profonda

 

ancora più evidente con l’aumento dei costi del carburante.




Oltre alla questione del sistema produttivo, esiste quella relativa alla 

Politica agricola comunitaria

 (PAC), su cui volevo darvi un paio di dati.È attualmente in discussione la nuova programmazione della politica agricola europea , nello specifico  la prossima fase che inizierà  dal 2027 (quadro PAC post 2027), e su cui è evidente che c’è pochissimo spazio di voce in capitolo da parte di chi lavora tutti i giorni in questo settore.




Nel periodo 2021-2027 la PAC ha concentrato 

oltre 378 miliardi di

 

fondi pubblici

 europei.

 Guardando alla suddivisione di questo budget tra imprese agricole, capiamo che questo è un 

esempio di concentrazione estrema anche dei finanziamenti pubblici

, perché come ci spiegheranno tra poco, è vero che questi finanziamenti sono divisi su vari ambiti, ma sappiamo che il grosso va alle produzioni gigantesche, talvolta anche attraverso la mediazione di prestanome societari. Le grandi multinazionali si stanno inserendo nella produzione del cibo ma non solo, perché un altro tema che tocchiamo oggi è quello del controllo dei territori e di una sottrazione di decisionalità sui territori che ci circondano.




Ne parleremo anche in relazione all’

agrivoltaico

, andando a capire come la questione energetica si intreccia con un accaparramento delle terre nelle mani, anche qui, di grandi multinazionali che davanti a un settore in crisi, davanti ad agricoltori e agricoltrici in crisi, cercano di comprare terreni per produrre energia. Energia che, spesso e volentieri, non viene neanche poi distribuita sul territorio. Analogamente, i territori ora vanno a confrontarsi anche con tutta la questione dei 

data center

.La risposta spesso è l’abbandono delle aree rurali, il che significa l’abbandono della produzione agricola, una sempre minore sovranità alimentare e capacità di produrre.




In conclusione, accenniamo a una questione che verrà ripresa sicuramente negli interventi: quella dello 

sfruttamento dei braccianti

 agricoli, cioè dei lavoratori stagionali in agricoltura, che è un altro elemento che si sta cercando di attenzionare sul territorio piemontese, e in particolare a Saluzzo.Ci sono nuovi coordinamenti che stanno nascendo intorno a questo tema e l’idea è di portarlo all’attenzione oggi e in generale nelle prossime mobilitazioni per far emergere come lo sfruttamento che si riproduce nel lavoro stagionale è figlio di quello sfruttamento economico della GDO e delle grandi multinazionali che si inseriscono in una dittatura di prezzo, in aste al ribasso, in dinamiche imposte che danno luce a questo fenomeno e alla sua riproduzione nel caporalato.




Arriviamo così al 2026, e ai temi a cui ho accennato si somma anche la questione del 

caro carburanti

, che di nuovo accende anche per agricoltori e agricoltrici un segnale di crisi importante e viene raccolto come occasione ulteriore di mobilitazione.A partire dal caro carburanti abbiamo visto soprattutto dal Centro-Sud Italia quella che è una sorta di alleanza nascente tra le mobilitazioni degli autotrasportatori, di vari settori del lavoro e della logistica, di agricoltori e agricoltrici e l’intera mobilitazione studentesca contro il carovita e il governo Meloni, che vediamo oggi anche qui a Palazzo Nuovo occupato.




Su questo, oggi, vorremmo interrogarci insieme.

author: Unknown
title: Памяти Ивана Хуторского
content:
Публикуем рассказ об Иване Хуторском. Автор - антифашист Олег Волин.

17 лет прошло как с нами нет нашего друга и товарища, известного антифашиста и анархиста Ивана Хуторского.

Его подло убил со спины ублюдок неонацист Коршунов из БОРН. Иван сделал очень многое для развития антифашистского движения в Москве и в России. Вечная слава героям!

16 ноября 2009 года был убит антифашист Иван Хуторской по прозвищу Костолом. Иван зашел в подъезд своего дома на окраине Москвы, привычно заглянул в почтовый ящик, и в это время нео-нацист Алексей Коршунов выстрелил ему в затылок. Спустя два года после совершения преступления этот ублюдок погиб, подорвавшись на собственной гранате.

Иван был добрым и отзывчивым человеком, всегда был готов прийти на помощь друзьям в любой ситуации. В наше смутное время этот человек для многих был примером несгибаемой воли и мужества. Иван до конца оставался предан своим убеждениям. Его уважали друзья и боялись враги.

Иван закончил юридический факультет МГАПИ и после смерти отца, оставшись единственным кормильцем семьи, работал в московском городском центре профилактики безнадзорности, преступности, алкоголизма, наркомании и СПИДа среди несовершеннолетних «Дети улиц» по специальности, юристом.

Иван занимался армрестлингом и самбо, участвовал в организации безопасности множества левых акций и музыкальных концертов. Был одним из организаторов антирасистских турниров по смешанным единоборствам «Не сдавайся!». Этот турнир собирает бойцов, разделяющих антирасистские взгляды, а также участников леворадикального движения.

Иван едва ли не первым среди столичных анархистов и антифашистов понял, что боевая подготовка и дисциплина должны стать одним из главных приоритетов антифашистского движения, и фактически выстроил нынешнюю модель спортивной подготовки «антифа». Первый такой турнир прошел в октябре 2009 года также в Москве в память об убитом нацистами антифашисте Фёдоре Филатове.

К несчастью, за время своей активной работы на благо движения Иван успел завести не только друзей, но и врагов.

Его адрес и имя, как и адреса и имена многих других известных антифашистов, таких как Станислав Маркелов и Николай Гиренко, неоднократно вывешивались на пронацистские сайты с призывами к его уничтожению. Первый раз на него напали нацисты в 2005 году и порезали бритвой голову. Второй раз нападавшие праворадикалы ждали его в подъезде. Ивану чудом удалось выжить. Он получил множественные ранения отверткой в область шеи, а также многочисленные удары бейсбольной битой. И уже в январе 2009 года во время уличной драки ему был нанесен удар ножом в живот, после которого Иван снова еле выжил. И вот только с четвертого раза нацисты добились своего, выстрелом из пистолета в затылок. Подло, исподтишка. Похороны Ивана в своей статье «Красные мартенсы» описал его знакомый, один из лучших журналистов России Андрей Лошак:

«Власть торжественно провожает Ивана Хуторского в последний путь „почетным караулом“ из десятков бойцов ОМОНа, перекрывших все подъезды к кладбищу. Опасаются терактов и провокаций. Возле крематория несколько сотен молодых людей, с первого взгляда напоминающих футбольных хулиганов. Хотя встречаются и панки…

Наконец все собираются возле гроба. Родственники, обычные русские люди, плачут. Друзья пока держатся. Тетенька говорит казенную фразу про последнее прощание с усопшим (какое неточное слово!). Первый ставит диск, и ритуальный зал взрывается жесткими звуками панк-рока. Тимура тоже хоронили под его любимую музыку. Кажется, это был Эллиотт Смит. С Ваней прощались под Stage Bottles, песня „Солидарность“. Вообще-то эта вещь в свое время была написана в поддержку польского рабочего движения. Но замени Polish на Russian — и песня станет идеальным саундтреком к яркой, честной и мужественной жизни Ивана:

Give them hope, give them strength, give them live like a candle burning in the black of night, we’re all with you in our hearts and in our minds, and we’ll pray for our nation through its darkest times

Под конец песни слезы текут у всех, включая молодых мужчин, явно не склонных к сантиментам. В их жизни уже давно все по-взрослому. Взаправду и очень серьезно. Они сделали то, что в их силах: очистили панк-культуру от коричневой грязи. Вымели, вышвырнули нечисть из своих клубов и подвалов. Теперь практически в одиночку ведут кровопролитную войну на улицах. Настоящие психи: их убивают, а они продолжают сопротивление. Нет чтобы играть вместе со всеми в „секретики“.»

Антифашисту Ивану Хуторскому в этом году было бы 43, но он навсегда остался 26 летним. Помним!

Фильм об Иване на английском языке можно посмотреть с субтитрами.

author: Natalia Viana
title: Deu a louca nos bots
content:
Quer receber os textos desta coluna em primeira mão no seu e-mail? Assine a newsletter Xeque na Democracia, enviada toda segunda-feira, 12h. Para receber as próximas edições, 

inscreva-se aqui.







Outro dia estava em Santiago do Chile, e quis compartilhar com os colegas chilenos 

este artigo

, no qual listo as maneiras como os EUA intervieram nas eleições brasileiras e, portanto, pedi ao Deepseek para traduzi-lo para o espanhol. 




O robozinho chinês realizou meu comando com presteza, mas foi além. Abaixo da tradução, após um emoji de alerta, ele avisou: “Nota importante: Se trata de um artigo de opinião/denúncia jornalística com uma linha editorial muito definida, não de um relato neutro”. Prosseguiu, dizendo que as afirmações eram interpretações, “não fatos confirmados independentemente”. E terminava: “Se você necessita deste resumo para um trabalho acadêmico ou uma decisão importante, convém contrastá-lo com outras fontes”. 




Não fiquei ofendida com a interpretação do robozinho, mas pasma – assustada é a palavra – com o fato de que 

ele não se limitou a cumprir o meu

 

prompt

, mas decidiu me alertar sobre o conteúdo do material

 que eu forneci a ele. 




As implicações disso são tremendas. Se você está acompanhando as notícias recentes sobre desenvolvimentos da IA, está pelo menos um pouco alarmado. 




Esta escapadela do Deepseek funciona mais como uma anedota interessante – não é o caso de que o robô decidiu agir sozinho, deve ser alguma nova atualização do chatbot que pretende ajudar a alertar sobre desinformação – e como um ponto de partida para uma reflexão sobre as consequências da adoção de tecnologias que evoluem rapidamente, são obstinadas e, falando em bom português, 

ninguém sabe bem como funcionam

: nem seus criadores, nem seus engenheiros, nem seus donos. 




A consequência do que fez o Deepseek é exatamente o que os 

tech bros

 fingiram não querer por tanto tempo: eis que o robozinho agora se arvora em dizer o que é verdade e o que não é. Isso, em um contexto privado, em uma relação desigual, onde uma pessoa/humana se volta para um robô/ferramenta em busca de conhecimento, ou seja, se portando como aprendiz. 

Nós, diante dos chatbots, estamos vulneráveis. E é perigosíssimo que eles façam um juízo de valor – sem serem requisitados a isso – sobre a informação que consumimos.

 




Na mesma semana em que o Deepseek me dizia que minha coluna é enviesada, jornais 

publicam

 que o correio da França foi hackeado e os dados de 22 milhões de franceses – um terço da população – foi comprometido. 




Apertem os cintos, essas notícias serão cada vez mais comuns. 




A verdade é que chegamos a novembro com um novo paradigma do desenvolvimento da IA, no qual agora somos obrigados a lidar com as consequências de termos jogado no mundo essas ferramentas que tomam decisões por si sós e que portanto, por princípio, não temos como controlar ou prever totalmente. Mudou de vez o paradigma da segurança digital. Tudo está sob ameaça. As câmeras do Smart Sampa. O Tinder. O E-gov. Os alertas da Defesa Civil. Tudo. 




Na imprensa internacional, os eventos de quebra de segurança recentes foram chamados de “outubro sombrio”. 




Um dos mais graves foi a descoberta de vulnerabilidades na linguagem de programação chamada PHP, amplamente usada por sites que vemos todos os dias, o que 

pode ter deixado

 70% de todos os sites na internet sob risco de serem invadidos – 

pessoas (ou robôs) poderiam assumir controle dos servidores, roubar dados, tirar os sites do ar.

 Antes do anúncio da vulnerabilidade, 

experts

 em cibersegurança já estavam detectando um aumento de ataques tentando explorar a falha em todo o mundo. Em resposta, a NSA (de triste memória) do governo dos EUA emitiu um alerta e diversos sites governamentais saíram do ar para implementar as correções. 




Um 

relatório

 do centro Halcyon, especializado em sequestro de dados digital, detectou um aumento de 40% de ataques do tipo entre julho e setembro deste ano, se comparado com os meses anteriores. É só um exemplo; diversos especialistas estão alertando para o fato de que 

estamos vivendo uma onda sem precedentes de ataques de segurança a sites do mundo todo. 




Jason Clinton, vice-diretor de segurança da informação da Anthropic, 

chamou

 de desastre o que o que estamos começando a vislumbrar. “O tsunami de vulnerabilidades está chegando em apenas alguns meses e não haverá tempo suficiente para corrigir a infraestrutura crítica”, escreveu no X.




Criminosos, agências de inteligência e segurança, governos autoritários, empresas corruptas, todos estão testando o que pode ser feito com os LLMs (Large Language Models)

 

disponíveis no mercado.

 




E em termos de explorar falhas em segurança na arquitetura do mundo digital, eles são imbatíveis. 




Uma reportagem recente da 

Reuters

, que tem como fonte o especialista em segurança Snorre Fagerland, traz com muita clareza como funciona este novo mundo. Ele conta que conseguiu mapear a ação de um cibercriminoso chinês que usou agentes para invadir sites de mais de 100 empresas, incluindo uma fabricante de eletrodomésticos e uma de motores da China. 




Segundo a Reuters, o que ele fez foi definir os alvos e passar aos seus agentes de IA uma instrução concisa – “invada” – e uma lista das suas táticas de intrusão preferidas. Incansáveis, os robozinhos passaram horas a fio em busca de vulnerabilidades em diferentes sites. Quando não encontraram, eles passaram a explorar vulnerabilidades em outros provedores de serviços ou infraestrutura associada. 




A busca pode ser infinita. 




Alguma vulnerabilidade, haverá.  




O 

expert

 entrevistado pela Reuters se disse “impressionado” pela capacidade dos agentes de resolver problemas complexos como esses. Ele diz ter comprovado que os agentes de IA que já existem no mercado podem fazer invasões complexas sem intervenção humana. 




Como sabemos, 

é bem difícil estabelecer limites para a IA.

 Se os robôs recebem uma ordem, vão buscar obstinadamente encontrar a solução. Não têm sono, não têm sede, não têm problemas familiares com que se preocupar; e são baratos. 




Fagerland estimou que a atividade do hacker chinês usava uma combinação do DeepSeek com o Claude Code, da Anthropic, e gastou apenas US$ 5.000 em tokens.




Os robôs, ainda por cima, não têm bom senso, apenas lógica. 




Assim como na emergência climática, à qual fomos jogados pela ganância de gerações de homens no poder, é este o mundo em que vivemos agora. 




Se os robôs só têm a lógica, seria bom que pelos menos os homens que comandam essas empresas – e os governos – tivessem algum bom senso e se unissem para regular de uma vez essa tecnologia

, decretando uma moratória imediata. 

Como comentei na semana passada

, é o que estão pedindo os votos nas urnas. 




Não me parece que é o que vai acontecer, infelizmente.

author: Mzi Velapi
title: Western Cape hit with tighter water restrictions
content:
The water and sanitation department has issued a warning to residents and businesses in the Western Cape that it will implement a 7% reduction in domestic and industrial water allocations as well as a 15% reduction in water for irrigation. Addressing the media on Monday, Minister of Water and Sanitation, Pemmy Majodina said that the current water in storage in the province is below the preferred operational threshold of 80%.




“While the major dams remain at acceptable levels overall, some key components of the system have recorded significant declines compared to the previous year. Storage levels remain significantly above those experienced during the severe drought period of 2016-2017; yet, the current water storage is below the preferred operational threshold of 80% and approximately 11.9 % points below the ten-year average of 84.49%,” Majodina said.




According to the minister, the decline in stored water resulted from below-average winter rainfall in the province while the looming El Niño event is increasing temperatures and evaporation.




Municipalities are expected to restrict water supply to residents and can impose further restrictions, but by no more than the 7% that the national government has imposed. The department is expected to write a submission to the director general who will approve the restriction and get it gazetted.




“Modelling undertaken by water resource specialists reveals that if water users continue to utilise their full allocations without intervention, the risk of water shortages and mandatory restrictions will increase substantially from 2027 onwards,” said Majodina.




The City of Cape has announced that it will introduce level 1 water restrictions from 1 December 2026.




Rural taps already dry




The Kannaland Local Municipality that covers Ladismith, Calitzdorp and Zoar are already on level 4 water restrictions. Water in the municipality is available for human consumption only.




Carmelitta Juries lives on a farm near Ladismith. While the farm dam is full, the water isn’t safe to drink without first disinfecting it with bleach. Carmelitta said they have no choice but to rely on the unsafe dam water as the municipality offers no alternative. “The municipality promised that they would put up water tanks. One tank could sustain a couple of homes. For example, 10 homes can use one tank, but to date we haven’t heard anything further,” she said.




Zoar resident, Irene Isaacs said that it is harder for the village to access water in summer. Community members without water storage tanks must wait for municipal trucks to deliver water. Elderly residents are especially vulnerable in these circumstances, she said, and depend on members of the community to carry water in buckets to their homes. 




Kannaland Municipality is already on level 4 restrictions. File photo by Mandla Mnyakama




Bergriver, Swartland and Saldanha Bay municipalities have been flagged as key areas where water scarcity and aging infrastructure pose significant constraints to future growth unless supply and bulk infrastructure are urgently upgraded. Hendrix Van Wyk from Vredenburg, which falls under Saldanha Bay Municipality, told 

Elitsha

 that in poor neighbourhoods like Hopland, Louwville, Selbou and Yskor, the water pressure in the taps is low. “It takes up to 30 minutes to fill up a 5-litre bucket and a 20-litre bucket takes about 2 hours to fill up,” he said.




According to Majodina, construction of the Clanwilliam Dam, which will increase water availability for the West Coast District Municipality, is 40% complete.




Partnership, not privatisation of water

 insists DWS




A 

new amendment to the Water Plan

 states that if a municipality is not delivering a clean, safe supply of water, the national government can hand that function over to the private sector. The government has already implemented this in the City of Tshwane where a public-private partnership is taking effect. According to 

BusinessTech

, Coca-Cola has partnered with the government to invest R500-million in municipal water infrastructure to stop service delivery from collapsing.




During Cape Town’s severe drought between 2015 and 2018, marked by the 

Day Zero Campaign

, water rights groups protested against water guzzlers, and the soft drink manufacturer was one of their targets. At the time, Coca-Cola drew about 530-million litres of water annually from the City of Cape Town to manufacture its products. A litre of Coke requires about 2 litres of water to produce.




Minister of Water and Sanitation, Pemmy Majodina during the opening of parliament this year. File photo by Mzi Velapi




The involvement of the private sector is seen by water rights groups as an early sign of water privatisation and exclusion of the poor.




During the media briefing, the acting director general, Dr Risimati Mathye denied that partnership with the private sector is ushering in the privatisation of water. “Government has never, in any way, taken a decision to privatise water. Yes, there is partnership that the government undertakes with the private sector, most especially integrated with their corporate social responsibility programmes but that is not necessarily privatisation of water. The government always invites the private sector to work with us to ensure that access to water is done but that is not privatisation,” Mathye said.
