Perspektivlos & entrechtet in Bosnien: Die Folgen der Abschottungspolitik  


„

Allein im ersten Halbjahr 2019 wurden rund 10.000 Geflüchtete in Bosnien-Herzegowina registriert. Die allermeisten benötigen dringend Unterstützung: Kurzfristig geht es um Verpflegung, Unterbringung & ärztliche Versorgung. Mittelfristig bedarf es einer Perspektive. Stattdessen werden Schutzsuchende im Auftrag der EU jedoch systematisch entrechtet. Seit langem werden Pushbacks, also Zurückweisungen ohne jedes rechtsstaatliches Verfahren, aus Kroatien nach Bosnien und auch die dabei eingesetzte Gewalt der kroatischen Grenzpolizei dokumentiert. Praktisch alle Geflüchteten, die in Bosnien stranden, berichten, Opfer solcher Zurückweisungen geworden zu sein. Aktivist*innen vor Ort, wie Border Violence Monitoring, und NGOs – etwa Ärzte ohne Grenzen, Human Rights Watch und Amnesty International – sowie Journalist*innen haben unzählige Belege für die Praktiken der Entrechtung und Gewalt veröffentlicht. Im Mai 2019 konnte das Schweizer Fernsehen Pushbacks selbst filmen. Ungeachtet der Nachweise hatte die kroatische Regierung monatelang abgestritten, dass es illegale Pushbacks gäbe und dass die kroatische Polizei Gewalt einsetzen würde. Erneut mit den Berichten konfrontiert, gab die kroatische Präsidentin Kolinda Grabar-Kitarović die Pushbacks und den Einsatz von Gewalt dann im Juli zu, zeigte sich allerdings unbeeindruckt von dem Vorwurf der Rechtswidrigkeit: »Illegale Push-Backs? Weshalb denken Sie, dass sie illegal sind? […] Natürlich gibt es ein bisschen Gewalt, wenn man Menschen abschiebt. Mir wurde vom Innenminister, vom Polizeichef und von den Polizisten vor Ort, die ich getroffen habe immer wieder versichert, dass sie nicht zu viel Gewalt anwenden.« Das Ausmaß der  bei den Pushbacks durch die kroatische Polizei eingesetzten Gewalt ist erschreckend – doch auch seitens einiger Grenzpolizist*innen regt sich Kritik, wie ein anonymer Brief vom März diesen Jahres an die kroatische Ombudsfrau Lora Vidović zeigt. Nach einer Änderung der Praktiken sieht es nicht aus, zumal es an internationalen Druck auf Kroatien fehlt. Das Schweigen der EU ist nicht verwunderlich: Kroatien setzt mit den Pushbacks die gemeinsame EU Abschottungspolitik praktisch um. Wie die Grenzpolizei dabei vorgeht, ist EU-Institutionen und Mitgliedsstaaten durch die Berichterstattung bekannt. Bei einem Treffen mit dem kroatischen Ministerpräsidenten Andrej Plenkovic im August 2018 würdigte Bundeskanzlerin Merkel die kroatische Migrationspolitik dennoch und lobte die »Sicherung« der Grenzen durch Kroatien

…“ 

Beitrag vom 16.08.2019 von und bei Pro Asyl 










Vorwürfe von NGO: Schiebt Kroatien illegal aus der EU ab?   


„

Schiebt das EU-Land Kroatien illegal Menschen nach Bosnien ab? Darauf weisen versteckt gefilmte Videos von der grünen EU-Außengrenze hin, die der ARD vorliegen. Der Beleg für einen alten Vorwurf?




Ein abgelegener Waldweg unmittelbar an der bosnisch-kroatischen Grenze. Ein kroatischer Polizist weist eine 14-köpfige Gruppe von Menschen lautstark zurecht, sie sollen sich in einer Reihe aufstellen. Der Polizist hat eine Pistole in der Hand. Ein weiterer Polizist ist zu sehen, wie er einen der Menschen mit einem Tritt zurück ins Glied schubst. Die Menschen laufen in Reih und Glied, die Hand auf der Schulter des Vordermanns und werden weitergeführt. Die Szene hat eine versteckte Kamera aufgenommen und ist Teil eines Videopakets, das die Nichtregierungsorganisation „Border Violence Monitoring“ dem ARD-Studio Südosteuropa zugespielt hat. Die insgesamt 132 Videos zeigen jeweils kleinere Gruppen von Menschen, die von kroatischen Polizisten über einen Waldweg Richtung Bosnien geführt werden. Sind das illegale Abschiebungen, wie sie der kroatischen Polizei seit langem vorgeworfen werden? Zu sehen sind im Zeitraum von zwölf Tagen im September und Oktober mindestens 368 Menschen, darunter auch Frauen und Kinder. (…) Der nächstgelegene Ort auf bosnischer Seite ist das Dorf Lohovo, etwa einen Kilometer vom Aufnahmeort entfernt. Dass immer wieder Menschen aus dem Wald kommen, und zwar nur in eine Richtung, weiß hier jeder. Der 89-jährige Rentner Gojko Stipić wohnt direkt am Wald: „Jeden Tag gehen hier 50 Menschen vorbei. Von oben kommen sie und gehen Richtung Bihac. In die andere Richtung gehen sie nicht.“ (…) Bestehende Rückführungsabkommen mit Bosnien und Herzegowina scheinen als Erklärung nicht in zu Frage kommen, denn diese offiziellen Abschiebungen finden an regulären Grenzübergängen statt. Handelt es sich hier um so genannte Push-Backs? Wenn ja, wäre das illegal, sagt Neven Crvenkovic, Sprecher des Flüchtlingshilfswerks UNHCR in Sarajevo

…“ 

Bericht von Srdjan Govedarica und Andrea Beer, ARD-Studio Wien, vom 16.12.2018 bei tagesschau.de 










Drohung gegen Migranten an der Grenze der USA? In Kroatien längst verwirklichter Terror




„

Am Sonntag fielen die Temperaturen in Velika Kladuša unter null Grad. Für die rund 400 Menschen, die hier im nordwestlichen Zipfel Bosnien-Herzegowinas an der Grenze zu Kroatien ­gestrandet sind, ist das eine schlechte Nachricht. Viele von ihnen leben in unbeheizten Zelten im Schlamm und sind auf freiwillige Helfer und internationale Organisationen angewiesen. Doch die Versorgungslage ist schlecht. Es werden nicht alle satt. Weder der bosnische Staat noch die EU scheinen sich verantwortlich zu fühlen. Sobald es hier richtig kalt wird, droht eine humani­täre Katastrophe. 

Hier, wo jahrhundertelang die Grenze zwischen dem christlichen Europa und dem Osmanischen Reich verlief, fordern die Geflüchteten Einlass in die Euro­päische Union und erhalten ihn nicht. Jeden Abend versuchen einzelne Gruppen über die Grenze zu gelangen, doch nur wenige schaffen es. Sie nennen es »das Spiel«, doch es ist bitterer Ernst. Einige haben blaue Flecken oder ge­brochene Gliedmaßen. Die kroatische Grenzpolizei ist für ihre Brutalität bekannt. Oft werden Menschen bei den sogenannten Push-Backs die Nase oder Knochen gebrochen, Zähne ausgeschlagen und die Handys abgenommen

…“ – aus dem 

Artikel „In der Push-Back-Zone“ von Krsto Lazarević am 22. November 2018 in der jungle world

 

 über den alltäglichen Terror an der EU-Außengrenze













„Stimmungsmache mit Messer-Migranten“ von Srdjan Govedarica am 05. November 2018 bei der ARD Wien

 

 ist ein Beitrag zur Hetzkampagne der Kronen Zeitung – darin durchaus den Trumpschen Freunden bei Fox vergleichbar – worin es einleitend heißt: „

Während Österreich intensiv über den Ausstieg des Landes aus dem globalen Migrationspakt diskutiert, erscheint am 04. November 2018 in der „Kronen Zeitung“ ein Artikel mit dem Titel: „Jetzt kommen ganz andere“. Was schreibt die Kronenzeitung? Ein Durchbruchsversuch von mindestens 20.000 Migranten aus dem bosnisch-kroatischen Grenzgebiet Richtung Mitteleuropa könnte kurz bevorstehen, schreibt das regierungsnahe Boulevardblatt. Einem Abteilungsleiter im Wiener Innenministerium liegen nach Angaben der „Kronen Zeitung“ entsprechende Informationen von „Verbindungsoffizieren“ aus dem bosnisch-kroatischen Grenzgebiet vor. Dort ist seit Monaten eine größere Anzahl von Migranten aus verschiedenen Ländern gestrandet. „95 Prozent dieser Migranten, die da durchbrechen wollen, sind junge Männer, fast alle mit Messer bewaffnet – zitiert die Kronen Zeitung „Beamte“ aus dem Innenministerium. Dabei sei die Versorgungslage der Menschen „relativ gut geregelt, denn viele der Migranten hätten Prepaid-Kreditkarten des UNHCR…

“. Den Erfindungen der gekrönten Fakenews-Produzenten werden dann die Fakten gegenüber gestellt.










„EU-Außengrenze: Kroatische Polizei geht offenbar mit Gewalt gegen Migranten vor“ von Hans von der Brelie am 31. Oktober 2018 bei den EuroNews

 

 berichtet unter anderem: „

Rund 5.000 Migranten sind an der EU-Außengrenze zwischen Bosnien-Herzegowina und Kroatien gestrandet. Eintausend haben Unterschlupf in einem ehemaligen Studentenwohnheim in Bihac, einer Stadt in unmittelbarer Nähe der Grenze gefunden. Von hier aus versuchen viele nachts nach Kroatien zu gelangen. Sie müssen hier in unhygienischen Verhältnissen leben, für hunderte Menschen stehen nur wenige Toiletten zur Verfügung. Der Geruch ist abstoßend. Nachts gibt es kaum Licht, Strom ist Mangelware. 

„Rund 1000 Migranten und Flüchtlinge leben in diesem verlassenen Haus. Es ist wirklich ein Skandal. Viele der Migranten hier beschweren sich über mutmaßliche Gewalt kroatischer Polizisten. Ich weiß nicht, ob es stimmt, aber spreche mit einigen, um mehr zu erfahren. „

 Wenn die kroatische Polizei die Migranten aufgreift, werden sie zur Umkehr nach Bosnien-Herzegowina gezwungen

…“










„Flüchtlinge in Bosnien: Verprügelt, hungrig und sich selbst überlassen“ von Andrej Ivanji am 26. Oktober 2018 beim MDR-Ostblogger

 

 zur Gewalt gegen Flüchtlinge: „

Die Männer stammen aus Syrien, Afghanistan, Nordafrika, Irak, Iran oder Pakistan. Sie erzählen von ihrer langen und gefährlichen Reise nach Europa. Alle haben es bis nach Kroatien, manche bis nach Slowenien geschafft, dann wurden sie festgenommen und zurück nach Bosnien-Herzegowina geschickt. Wieso gerade dorthin? Das wissen sie nicht. Ende Oktober war es am Grenzübergang zu heftigen Zusammenstößen zwischen einigen hundert Flüchtlingen und der bosnischen Polizei gekommen. Die Polizei hinderte die Migranten daran, Absperrungen zu durchbrechen, um nach Kroatien zu gelangen. Die Flüchtlinge beklagen sich über die Brutalität der kroatischen Polizei. „Das sind Rassisten“, sagt Achraf. Er erzählt, wie sie ihn zuerst mit grellem Licht geblendet, dann eingekreist und minutenlang verprügelt hätten. Auch Frauen und Kinder hätten sie geschlagen. Einige Männer zeigen Prellungen und blaue Flecken. Einige erzählen, dass die kroatische Polizei sie vor dem UNHCR-Büro in Zagreb oder vor dem staatlichen Büro für Asylanträge festgenommen hätten. Geld und Handys hätten sie ihnen weggenommen. Die Flüchtlinge verstehen nicht, warum sie in Europa nicht gewollt sind, und dass sie gar keine Chancen auf Asyl haben. Aufgeben wollen sie aber auf gar keinem Fall. Auf Anordnung von lokalen Behörden dürfen Flüchtlingen nicht länger Bustickets verkauft werden. Ohne Geld sitzen hier viele fest

…“










„#NoBorders, #Croatia: ”Police also beated the woman and her children could see it and were crying”- Police Violence Report“ von Karolina Augustová am 04. November 2018 bei Enough is Enough

 

 

dokumentiert, ist einer der Tagesberichte der Initiative No name kitchen über die Repressionsmaßnahmen an den Grenzen zu Kroatien. Darin kommen die Opfer der nahezu ununterbrochenen Polizeiangriffe zu Wort, die ihre jeweiligen Erlebnisse schildern – die meist aus Prügeln für alle und jede bestehen…










„Future beyond the police hammer and humanitarian anvil“ am 08. November 2018 bei Reakcija

 

 ist Erklärung und Aufruf zu den Entwicklungen in Kroatien, seitdem der Zug der MigrantInnen am 22. Oktober an der kroatischen Grenze aufgehalten wurde. Darin wird sowohl die Brutalität des Vorgehens der kroatischen Polizei kritisiert, als auch und insbesondere die gleichgeschaltete Hetzkampagne kroatischer Medien. Unterzeichnet ist die Erklärung bisher von über 800 Einzelpersonen und etwa 60 Organisationen.







Der Beitrag 

Die Migrations-Karawane auf dem Balkan: Niemand droht mit der Armee. Die Polizei ist schon da…

 erschien zuerst auf 

LabourNet Germany

.

title: Emma Goldman. Une femme extrêmement dangereuse. Vostfr
content:
Emma Goldman


Une femme extrêmement dangereuse


(Vostfr)




Emma Goldman


(27 juin 1869 – 14 mai 1940).




Une célèbre anarchiste d'origine lituanienne connue pour ses écrits et ses manifestes libertaires et féministes.


À 16 ans, elle émigre aux États-Unis. Elle rejoint le mouvement libertaire lors de la lutte contre l'exécution des 4 anarchistes martyrs de Chicago.


Elle est emprisonnée plusieurs fois pour ses prises de positions anticapitalistes, féministes et pacifistes lors de la 1ère guerre mondiale.


En 1919, qualifiée de "femme la plus dangereuse  d'Amérique" par le fondateur du FBI, J. Edgar Hoover, elle est expulsée des États-Unis et déportée en Russie.


Choquée par la répression meurtrière menée par les bolchéviques contre toute tentative de libre expression, elle finit par quitter le pays pour mener une campagne de  dénonciation de cette dérive autoritaire.


En 1936, pendant la guerre civile, elle collabore avec les libertaires espagnols dont elle sera la porte-parole à Londres.


Mai 1940, elle meurt  au Canada. Elle est enterrée au cimetière de Chicago, tout près des martyrs de Haymarket.




Titre original :


American Experience S16.E07.


"Emma Goldman. An exceedingly dangerous woman."


2004 - 90 minutes


Écrit et réalisé par Mel Bucklin

title: Police violently disperse, arrest hundreds in Muntinlupa protest
content:
More than a hundred protesters were arrested today, November 15 after police dispersed the contingent of progressive groups in the Southern Tagalog region who will be joining the protest next week in time for US President Donald Trumps’a arrival in the country.

After a long stand off between the police and the protesters, the Lakbayan Southern Tagalog was dispersed by the Southern Police District at Sucat People’s Park in Muntinlupa City at past 2:00 p.m., leading to the arrest of roughly 300 individuals, including more than 10 student journalists and alternative media reporters.

The protesters were headed to the Kampuhan protest at Liwasang Bonifacio in Manila to protest against the Pax Silica initiative and the arrival of U.S. President Donald Trump for the ASEAN Summit in Pasay; however they were halted in Sucat, Muntinlupa.

Witnesses reported that initial negotiations with the police were conducted to allow the demonstrators to proceed with the protest.

Shortly after, police officers reportedly issued a final warning, stating, “Pasensyahan po, pinagbigyan namin kayo pero ayaw niyo sumunod,” before moving in to break up the assembly.

Witnesses reported that the dispersal quickly escalated and turned violent as police officers began dragging away participants.

One demonstrator recounted attempting to intervene after seeing a fellow protester being dragged by police. Alongside a T.U. and the Vice President of M.C., the witness attempted to assist the protester, only to be arrested afterwards.

Despite repeatedly stating that they were willing to submit to a voluntary arrest, the protesters claimed they continued to be subjected to physical force. One protester recounted how after managing to stand up, they were allegedly pushed toward the nearby police station, dragged once more, and brought to the station entrance.

Human rights group Karapatan said, “The PNP has turned a public space meant for the exercise of people’s democratic rights into a site of violence and repression. Karapatan condemns these acts of brutality and demands accountability from the police officers and commanders responsible,”

“These disturbing scenes, recorded in full public view, expose the brutality of the police and the extent to which state forces are willing to go to suppress dissent,” said Cristina Palabay, Karapatan secretary general in a statement.

Palabay said the Marcos regime’s relentless crackdown on protesters exposes its desperation to appease the US government and serve its interests at the expense of the Filipino people’s fundamental rights.

Palabay said the arrested protesters must be immediately released. She added that while in police custody, they must be guaranteed access to their legal counsel, paralegals, relatives, and representatives of their respective organizations, as well as immediate medical attention.

“We demand that the PNP stop all forms of physical and psychological abuse against them,” Palabay said.

In a statement, the College Editors Guild of the Philippines (CEGP) confirmed that more than 10 campus and alternative media journalists were arrested, including: three from their group, nine from the UP Los Baños Perspective, three from the Southern Tagalog Exposure, and one member each from The Stape, Philippine Collegian, and CCC The Sentinel, alongside campus journalists from Parañaque and UP Baguio.

The CEGP vehemently condemned the mass arrests and over 24 hours of harassment and intimidation, describing the operations as a deliberate crackdown on press freedom and peaceful dissent stemming from Ferdinand Marcos Jr. ‘s “overkill” police deployment.

“Not only are those who participate in the protests being targeted, but publications that highlight the grassroot struggle of those who are affected by Pax Silica,” the CEGP stated.

Altermidya Network also condemned the arrest saying, “The government cannot claim to uphold democratic freedoms before the international community while police forces suppress public demonstrations and interfere with journalists documenting events on the ground.” (With reports from Anne Marxze Umil) (AMU,RVO)

title: Biçer: Kurdish cinema must build historical awareness in peace process
content:
Kurdish cinema in Turkey has faced censorship and repression throughout its history. Not only Kurdish cinema but also film and television projects dealing with Kurdistan have been forced to contend with censorship and pressure from successive governments.




Documentaries and films struggle to find venues for screenings, while cinemas refuse to show these productions. Most recently, the film Rojbash, which focuses on Teatra Jiyana Nû, has still not been released. Legal proceedings concerning the film are also ongoing. Another production unable to secure screening venues is a documentary about the Vartinis massacre.




Director Ömer Biçer, who documented the Vartinis massacre, spoke to ANF about the problems facing Kurdish cinema and the role of cinema in the struggle for peace.




‘I saw cinema as a responsibility’




Director Ömer Biçer, who began working in cinema in 2021, described how he became involved in filmmaking and his journey towards directing. Biçer said that he entered the world of cinema after meeting friends at Istasyon Akademi Mezopotamya Sinema.




Biçer said: “I was looking for an answer to the question, ‘Could I become a filmmaker?’ I believed that cinema was a collective art form and that we could become filmmakers by taking part in any aspect of it. However, looking at my earliest works, I found myself directing, which is one of the areas of cinema that carries the greatest responsibility in terms of production.




The reason was that, in 2021, Kurdistan and Turkey were experiencing difficult conditions of war, which affected every field of art. Making art was becoming increasingly difficult, particularly filmmaking. I saw this as a responsibility. It reminded me of something Ahmedê Xanî said when writing Mem û Zîn: ‘Hanî ji kemala bêkemalî / Meydana kemalê dît valî.’ In other words, Xanî saw a void in the field of artistic excellence. He wrote Mem û Zîn not because he considered himself exceptionally talented, but out of love for his people and a sense of national responsibility. I can say that I found myself in a similar situation and felt something similar.”




‘Kurdish society also guides its artists’




Biçer said that before making the Vartinis documentary, he had produced a short film addressing a public health problem that emerged during the resistance in Sur. 




Biçer continued: “Before Vartinis, I actually made a film called Sêhiya Gel in 2024. It dealt with a public health problem during the Sur resistance in 2015. During the post-production stage, after filming had been completed, this story and project came to me. It was actually a request from the people of Vartinis.




I think I felt ready for it, as though I had been preparing for years. A group of people came and said, ‘This is what happened to us, and this is how it ended. There was a massacre, followed by a second massacre through the legal system. We do not want this to be forgotten.’




At that point, regardless of whether someone is a filmmaker, whether new or experienced, any human being would try to become part of that story.




Anyone with a sense of moral responsibility would say, ‘Something like this has happened, I have been asked to take part, and I will accept that responsibility.’ That was the concern that motivated us to begin.




But both while making Vartinis and through the reactions we received afterwards, we were reminded of something: Kurdish society is genuinely dynamic and political. What I saw was that Kurdish society can also guide its artists. What was Kurdish cinema dealing with? What kind of narrative was it pursuing? When the issue of Vartinis emerged, we could see that everything else it had been dealing with suddenly lost much of its significance. That is how the process of telling the story of Vartinis began.”




‘There was also a public health crisis during the Sur resistance’




Biçer also discussed his short film Sêhiya Gel, which addresses events during the Sur resistance: “I was in Amed (Diyarbakır), about 100 metres from Diyarbakır Square, close to Sur. I was dealing with some paperwork at a notary's office when we learned that a woman had been killed by the police. The woman, Mızgın Kılıç, whose code name was Ruken Amed, was killed by police officers while trying to enter Sur to support the resistance fighters there.




That was when I felt that the war was continuing and that its psychological effects were affecting public health. How healthy were those who remained healthy? What was the ethical cost of remaining healthy?




This is being discussed now and will certainly continue to be discussed in the future. I questioned myself: ‘Have we become too accustomed to this war taking place right beside us? Has it become too much a part of our everyday lives?’ It was happening right beside me, very close to where I was. Once again, driven by a sense of responsibility, I began asking, ‘Such an event has taken place in history. What can we do as individuals and as artists?’ That was how the idea of developing this story emerged.




If we were going to make a film about the war in Sur, there were two conventional approaches. The first was to make a film directly depicting the front line and the war itself, as Ersin Çelik did in Ji Bo Azadiyê. The second was to tell the story more indirectly, through its consequences. I chose the second approach, both because of the technical conditions and because I preferred that narrative style.




When we ask, ‘What happened in Sur beyond what we witnessed?’, we find that there was a very serious public health crisis. The first observed problem was that women in Amed experienced irregular menstrual cycles due to stress during that period. The second was that psychiatric patients receiving treatment at home deteriorated to the point of requiring clinical care, again because of stress. This increased pressure on the healthcare system and eventually led to its collapse in some areas.




I chose the second issue. I did not want to risk making technical mistakes as a man when telling a woman's story, so I did not take that path. I hope a female colleague will tell that story in the near future.




Regarding the second issue, the deterioration of patients receiving treatment at home and the collapse of the healthcare system, I tried to portray something specific in the film. Everyone except the patient character was carrying on with their lives as before. The boy was the only person whose behaviour negatively affected everyday life. Yet, at the same time, he was the only one who did not pay the ethical price of remaining healthy in a place where war was taking place. If the psychiatric difficulties he experienced amounted to a state of madness, I think we need to question our own state of being healthy.




Another issue is how people gradually adapt to such situations within the system. In the film, everyone, from the patriotic doctor to the nurse and the family, works together to suppress the boy's reaction. People living in an area where the war was extremely intense wanted the clashes to end. The effort to silence the boy's screams was actually a form of self-criticism.”




‘We must create more opportunities for Kurdish films to reach Kurdish audiences’




Biçer said that Kurdish cinema had fallen short in portraying what people had experienced. He argued that Kurdish filmmakers must first answer whether they make films to reach audiences or to have their work screened at festivals.




Biçer also said: “If I were to answer whether Kurdish cinema reflects these experiences from the perspective of a viewer, I would say that it falls considerably short. In fact, there is another issue. I think the question ‘Why do we make cinema?’ is one that everyone involved in Kurdish cinema, from producers to screenwriters, must ask themselves from the outset.




One of the most fundamental problems facing Kurdish cinema is its inability to reach its audience. As a result, filmmakers move away from general audiences towards film festivals where they can screen their work. This leaves them facing a choice: Kurdish audiences or festival audiences? Many of these festivals take place abroad or in Turkey.




Public screenings of films in Kurdistan have been extremely limited. Eventually, filmmakers began producing films suited to the platforms where they can secure screenings. This takes the question ‘Who are we making cinema for?’ in another direction. Unfortunately, we cannot see a cinema being created for Kurdish people.




Returning to the question of how adequately Kurdish cinema reflects these problems, we can say that it falls short. Filmmakers cannot convey their work directly to the people whose concerns they are addressing. To close this gap, we must first increase opportunities for Kurdish films to reach Kurdish audiences. If filmmakers were as committed to their own audiences as they are to festivals, they could establish a closer connection with their own stories.”




‘I think some filmmakers have abandoned resistance cinema too early’




Ömer Biçer said that cinema also has an important role to play in the Peace and Democratic Society Process. He said: “We can regard Kurdish cinema as a reflection of the Kurdish people's own circumstances. As the problems underlying the Kurdish question are resolved, some of the obstacles facing Kurdish cinema will also disappear. I see a very strong parallel here. However, I have also noticed something. There have been certain developments and gains in the political sphere. The peace process itself is a major achievement, but these gains have not yet been translated into cultural achievements.




Therefore, I think certain groups within Kurdish cinema have prematurely abandoned the legacy of anti-colonial Kurdish cinema and resistance cinema. Despite the difficulties surrounding production, Kurdish filmmakers maintained a very strong stance. Yet I can see that these values are being abandoned earlier than they should be.




The cessation of hostilities is a major achievement, but it is not a cultural achievement. Cultural workers should be continuing their struggle from where they left off, and even more intensively. Instead, I think we have somewhat loosened our commitment to the legacy of anti-colonial and resistance cinema, as though these political developments had already become cultural achievements. Actions that would have been met with opposition just a year ago are now reaching a point where they are being encouraged. I think it is too early for that.




Therefore, the greatest contribution Kurdish artists can make to peace is to continue telling the stories of resistance and anti-colonial cinema, convey these experiences to their own people and build historical awareness. I believe we must act within the framework of our existing cinematic and political traditions to prevent this legacy from being abandoned prematurely.”

title: Social siege in Yüksekova: Children, women and youth targeted - Part One
content:
Allegations of child sexual abuse, harassment and sexual assault against women in Hakkari (Colemêrg), particularly in Yüksekova (Gever), have brought long-standing social problems in the district back into focus. A case involving allegations of sexual abuse of a 13-year-old child, in which school bus driver Eren Oğuz and local musician and security guard Necat Koparan are named, has been brought before the judiciary. Separately, several women have filed complaints alleging harassment and sexual assault by Nevzat Çiftçi, a local musician who performs at weddings. The fact that both men are well known in the district, perform at weddings and maintain connections with different sections of society raises the need to examine these incidents in a broader context. Are these merely isolated cases, or are they part of a wider social siege targeting young people, women and children through special warfare policies?




Yüksekova is a Kurdish town known for its strong neighborhood culture, close relations among neighbors and tradition of social solidarity. Over the years, this social structure has become a target of the state's repression and security policies. The curfews and clashes that began with the declaration of self-rule in Yüksekova on 13 August 2015 resulted in widespread destruction. Neighborhoods were demolished and thousands of families were displaced. The destruction targeted not only physical spaces but also relations of neighborliness and solidarity. The subsequent reconstruction of the town accelerated the replacement of neighborhood culture with a consumption-oriented way of life.




Today, discussions about Yüksekova point to a multidimensional social siege, ranging from abuse targeting children and women to drugs, loan sharking and money laundering networks, and from the criminalization of young people to divisions deepened through tribalism. The erosion of social values, from wedding culture and everyday life to economic relations and local power networks, is also part of this picture. The latest case involving the alleged sexual assault of a 13-year-old child has once again highlighted the extent of the problems surrounding children's safety and protection. This report examines how social life in Yüksekova has been targeted through special warfare policies and the transformations these policies have brought about.




Child sexual abuse and threats involving images




The sexual abuse case involving a 13-year-old child in Yüksekova has once again raised concerns about children's safety and protection in the district. The case, which has been referred to the judiciary, names school bus driver Eren Oğuz and Necat Koparan, a local musician, wedding performer and security guard. The child reportedly described the abuse in a statement given at the Child Monitoring Center, saying that images of the child had been used to make threats and that attempts had been made to obstruct the child's education. The threats and pressure the child reportedly faced after the abuse indicate that the incident was not limited to the alleged sexual abuse itself. Threats involving images and interference with the child's right to education are also significant aspects of the case. The suspects' release after giving their statements has raised questions about how the investigation is being conducted, how the child is being protected and what support mechanisms will be put in place.




Eren Oğuz's position as a school bus driver is particularly significant because families entrust their children to drivers during their journeys to and from school. Children's safety and the protection of this relationship of trust are therefore central concerns. Necat Koparan's status as a security guard and his position in society as a local musician are other notable aspects of the case. Peoples' Equality and Democracy Party (DEM Party) MP for Hakkari, Öznur Bartın, also brought the issue before parliament, submitting a parliamentary question to the Ministry of Family and Social Services.




Years of abuse and harassment cases in Yüksekova and Hakkari




The latest case involving the alleged sexual assault of a 13-year-old child is not the first such incident reported in Yüksekova or other districts of Hakkari. Over the years, allegations of child sexual abuse, harassment and sexual assault against women, as well as cases involving threats and blackmail, have emerged at different times. Some of these cases have resulted in convictions, others remain before the courts, and some have ended in acquittals.




2024: Allegations of harassment involving specialist sergeants in Çukurca (Çelê):

 Two girls aged 16 and 17 were reportedly harassed by specialist sergeants during a festival concert in Çukurca. Two specialist sergeants were detained and subsequently released. In a statement, the district governor's office described the incident as an intoxicated person holding the hand of a 16-year-old girl.




2024: Harassment allegations against a specialist sergeant in Hakkari:

 A specialist sergeant was accused of harassing a young woman for approximately one month and continuing to send her messages on social media even after her family filed a complaint. Members of the family were reportedly detained following an argument with the suspect.




2023: Alleged child sexual abuse in Derecik (Rûbarok): 

A child aged nine or ten was allegedly taken to a barn by a neighbor and sexually abused. The child was heard in court in the presence of a child development specialist. The trial was postponed until 2026.




2023: Security guard sentenced to 17 years and six months in prison: 

In the case of D.E., who was reportedly subjected to systematic sexual abuse by two cousins from the age of 13, one of the defendants was identified as a security guard. One defendant died in 2017. In December 2023, the other defendant, Sedat E., was sentenced to 17 years and six months in prison following a retrial.




2023: Acquittals in the Esra Yücel case:

 Eleven-year-old Esra Yücel, who lived in Oğlaklı village in Şemdinli (Şemzinan), was allegedly sexually abused and then thrown from a cliff. In November 2023, three defendants were acquitted due to insufficient evidence.




2022: Photographs of 26 women stolen: 

Photographs of 26 women in Yüksekova were reportedly obtained and used on fake social media accounts, exposing the women to threats and harassment. The women sought assistance from the Human Rights Association (IHD).




2021: Alleged blackmail network involving security guards and specialist sergeants:

 Allegations emerged concerning a blackmail and prostitution network in Hakkari and Şırnak (Şirnex), reportedly involving security guards, specialist sergeants and civilians. Women were allegedly drugged and subjected to abuse, while images of them were recorded and used for blackmail. An investigation into the allegations was reportedly launched.




2021: Alleged sexual abuse of a five-year-old child in Derecik:

 A suspect was arrested in connection with allegations of sexual abuse involving a five-year-old child. The Hakkari Bar Association stated that the family had been pressured not to file a complaint.




2021: Sexual assault complaint against a police officer: 

A complaint was filed against police officer E.T. over allegations that he sexually assaulted G.A.Ü., who worked at the same institution, in Hakkari. In a statement, the governor's office said that the complaint had been withdrawn and subsequently filed again after an attempted marriage arrangement failed. The suspect was suspended from duty and an administrative investigation was launched.




2019: Assault and threats allegedly involving a village guard commander in Akocak:

 Village guard commander Ümit Yalçıntuna was accused of sexually assaulting a young woman and threatening her family. The family was allegedly pressured to withdraw its complaint, while police reportedly proposed marriage as a means of reaching a settlement.




2019: Alleged abuse of two siblings in Büyükçiftlik: 

Security guard Sedat E. was prosecuted over allegations of sexually abusing two siblings aged six and twelve. The court ruled that the defendant could stand trial without being held in custody.




2019–2020: Sexual abuse of a nine-year-old child in Yüksekova: 

In a case involving the sexual abuse of a nine-year-old child, defendant M.A. was sentenced to a total of 62 years and six months in prison.




These cases reveal common patterns among allegations involving different individuals over several years: children and women being subjected to sexual violence, attempts to silence them through threats and blackmail, incidents involving allegations against public officials, and serious questions surrounding investigative procedures.




The incidents in Yüksekova, together with the lack of social response, also highlight the need to examine special warfare policies beyond the sphere of security and armed conflict. They raise questions about the impact of these policies on social relations, the lives of women and children, and the future of young people.




What do these cases tell us?




What do these sexual assault cases spanning several years tell us? On one side are allegations of abuse, harassment and assault targeting children and women. On the other are threats, blackmail, coercion involving images and pressure to withdraw complaints. Security guards, specialist sergeants and public officials are named in these criminal cases. Some trials have resulted in convictions, others in acquittals, while some cases have remained unresolved for years.




Two individuals whose names have recently returned to public attention, Necat Koparan and Nevzat Çiftçi, are well-known local wedding musicians. The fact that Koparan is also a security guard makes the child sexual abuse allegations brought before the judiciary against him particularly significant. Eren Oğuz, meanwhile, is a school bus driver. The involvement of someone entrusted by families with the safety of their children in such a case raises serious concerns. Moreover, the victim in the latest case is a 13-year-old child.




But how much of what has happened do these publicly reported cases actually reveal? How many women and children have been unable to file complaints, remained silent because of threats, been forced to withdraw under family pressure or lacked the strength to speak about their experiences? How many cases were never opened, and how many victims were never heard? The answers to these questions remain unknown. But one thing is clear: The safety of children and women, the future of young people and solidarity within society in Yüksekova are under severe siege. Treating these incidents as isolated criminal cases means ignoring the broader picture.




State repression, social disintegration, drug trafficking and criminal networks, and the targeting of women and children are all interconnected. This is what is known as special warfare.

author: Agatha Hazel Rabino
title: Press freedom advocates condemn police brutality as 20 media workers nabbed while covering ASEAN protests
content:
At least 20 media workers from various campus publications and community media outfits were arrested while on coverage on Sunday, November 15, at Sucat People’s Park Muntinlupa.

The journalists were covering the Lakbayan ng Timog Katagalugan which was originally set to continue towards the Kampuhan in Liwasang Bonifacio today. Mass arrests have followed while the organizers of the group were still in the middle of negotiating with the police to let them continue their protest.

As of press time, publication members from the UPLB Perspective, The Staple, Philippine Collegian, CCC The Sentinel were confirmed to be among those arrested. Meanwhile, 3 journalists from Southern Tagalog Exposure (STex), 3 coordinators from College Editors Guild of the Philippines ST and journalists from Parañaque and UP Baguio were also apprehended.

Alternative media alliance Altermidya Network condemned the police violence against the protesters and journalists.

“These incidents raise serious concerns about the safety of journalists covering public demonstrations and the conduct of police operations during the ASEAN Summit,” the network said in a statement.

Altermidya also added that several cases of harassment and manhandling of journalists were also documented during the morning protest at Liwasang Bonifacio.

“The government cannot claim to uphold democratic freedoms before the international community while police forces suppress public demonstrations and interfere with journalists documenting events on the ground. Security preparations for an international gathering do not suspend constitutional rights. Freedom of expression, peaceful assembly, and press freedom must be respected, including when citizens express opposition to government policies and international agreements,” it furthered.

Meanwhile, the College Editors Guild of the Philippines (CEGP) also condemned the police operations against protesters and members of the campus press.

“The Guild vehemently condemns the mass arrests carried out by state forces, as these constitute clear violations of press freedom and attempts to suppress coverage of Lakbayan and Kampuhan, where people from different sectors are expressing their rejection of Pax Silica and Trump’s visit.

These mass arrests, acts of hamletting, intimidation harassment and attempted arrests for over 24 hours are deliberate crackdowns on freedom of expression. Not only are those who participate in the protests being targeted, but publications that highlight the grassroot struggle of those who are affected by Pax Silica. This stems from Marcos’ overkill order of police deployment to silence peaceful dissent,” CEGP said.

Following the arrests, press freedom advocates called for the immediate and unconditional release of journalists and protesters nabbed during the police operations.

“We demand that the Philippine National Police disclose the whereabouts and legal status of all those arrested, guarantee their safety, and ensure their immediate access to legal counsel. We also demand an independent investigation into the arrests, the harassment and manhandling of media workers, the attempted arrests of campus journalists, and other reported acts of police violence against journalists and protesters. Police personnel found responsible for unlawful actions must be held accountable,” it said.

It also called for the support of fellow media organizations, campus publications, press freedom advocates, and other human rights group to stand with their detained and harassed colleagues and to defend the people’s right to know.

author: dialogocomospovos
title: Reforma agrária é transformação
content:
No intercâmbio com lideranças indígenas do Mato Grosso do Sul, os participantes puderam conhecer o trabalho de Mestre Isaac com a horta orgânica no Assentamento Terra Vista e compreender um pouco mais da história e da filosofia que sustentam essa prática.




Isaac explicou que o coletivo não cabe em quadrado: a horta é dele, mas é coletiva ao mesmo tempo, porque serve à comunidade e aos encontros realizados no assentamento. Foi feita para incentivar o coletivo e também quem estava desanimado e não acreditava.




Segundo ele, o objetivo da terra não é enriquecer; vieram para ensinar e aprender. A reforma agrária, afirmou, diz respeito à transformação e à diversidade, e o assentamento já formou médico, advogado, engenheiro, agrônomo e enfermeiro.




A natureza pediu esse cuidado: poder alimentar-se bem e viver sossegado, tranquilo. Na cidade, disse, a pessoa vegeta, acorda, levanta e trabalha assustada; no assentamento há porta aberta, água pura sem cloro nem veneno e fruta natural.




Ele contou que viveu 18 anos no Espírito Santo com a cabeça impregnada pela ganância, tinha café e tratava tudo de forma brutal, até perceber que estava errado e matando a si mesmo ao bater herbicida e jogar veneno na cara do outro. Ao chegar, começou a pensar e enfrentou desafios sem correr, acreditando na força da natureza.




Além da horta, tem roça de cacau e já teve 14 mil pés de café, mas precisou parar por causa de hérnias de disco. Às margens do rio Aliança, os participantes conversaram sobre essa trajetória, sobre o que vieram fazer na terra e sobre a importância de trabalhar tranquilo, sossegado e em coletivo.

author: Unknown
title: The memory of a cartoon: From Qırıx to Bajar
content:
Doğan Güzel's cartoons carry a collective memory stretching from the streets of Diyarbakır (Amed) in the 1990s to the present day. Born out of everyday life, political conflicts and social contradictions, Qırıx gradually became more than a cartoon character, emerging as a figure representing the youth of the period and the transformation experienced by Kurdish society. Güzel's work, which continued through humor publications such as Gırgır, TEW-LO, Pîne and Zrîng, has now taken a new form with Bajar magazine. This long-running journey seeks not only to preserve the collective memory of the past but also to create space for the written use of Kurdish through cartoons and comics.




Güzel's journey as a cartoonist began with a character he created by observing the people around him and the political atmosphere of the time. Doğan Güzel, who spoke to ANF, said that he began drawing cartoons for Gırgır magazine and described his need to create a character he could draw every day.




Güzel said: "Since I was among patriotic young people, I wanted to create a character I could draw every day without too much difficulty whenever I needed to produce something in response to newspaper headlines. I looked around and observed my fellow students. I tried to create a character by combining Kurdish culture with something familiar to me. I think the character resonated with people because I drew him sincerely, without forcing myself too much.




Although my drawings were amateurish, I was naturally reflecting the period as I tried to portray the people around me. I was depicting the world of young people who were just becoming involved in politics, taking part in protests and experiencing uncertainty. I combined the experiences of students in Istanbul with the social reality of Kurdish people. Perhaps that is why the character became popular. When you draw by observing your surroundings, you also reflect the pulse of the country you live in."




Qırıx first appears in Özgür Gündem




Qırıx appeared in the pages of Özgür Gündem between 1992 and 1995. Politics in the character's world was not limited to developments reported in newspaper headlines. Young people's friendships, everyday decisions, uncertainties about joining the struggle and questions about how to lead their lives were also part of that world.




Güzel described the political atmosphere in which the character emerged and the uncertainties experienced by young people. 




Güzel said: "There was intense political activity in Istanbul in 1991, 1992 and 1993. It was a period when Kurdish young people were discovering their identities and becoming involved in politics, with demonstrations taking place every day. Young people felt they had to make major decisions. They were asking themselves, 'What should I do? How should I act? Where do I stand in this struggle?' This atmosphere was reflected in my cartoons. Keko's incomplete understanding of politics, his uncertainty about whether to join the struggle, his constant changes of mind and the ambiguity over whether these feelings were sincere or driven by other reasons reflected the experiences of young people at the time. There were strong similarities between what was happening in Kurdistan and the experiences of young people in Istanbul. The problems were shared, and young people were confronting similar questions."




Qırıx's significance lay not in being a character who observed the political struggle from the outside, but in embodying the contradictions experienced by young people in his own everyday life. The character reflected a generation struggling to make decisions, changing alongside social conditions and sometimes confronting its own contradictions.




T

he politics of everyday life







The years in which Qırıx emerged were marked by armed clashes, detentions, village evacuations and state violence that shaped everyday life in Kurdish cities. Güzel's cartoons, however, portrayed this harsh reality not simply through political messages but also through the seemingly ordinary lives of people.




Güzel said that he had not initially expected his drawings to attract so much attention. He described his style as different from conventional newspaper humor and reflected on both the character's popularity and the discomfort it caused.




Güzel also said: "I started drawing cartoons at a very young age. Initially, I did not think my work would attract so much attention. My style was different from conventional newspaper humor. I had a more absurdist approach to humor, and I did not expect my drawings to receive much attention. Over time, however, I realized that portraying Kurdish experiences so naturally and as something legitimate through a character loved in patriotic circles was itself enough to cause discomfort.




I was portraying someone who could be seen as a terrorist by Turks and as an adventurer by Kurds, but I was showing his human side. I drew him as one of us, someone who lived and thought like us. I think that was what attracted the most attention."




The human qualities, fears, weaknesses and contradictions of Güzel's characters also found expression in his drawings. A way of life portrayed from the outside as dangerous or extraordinary was thus depicted through the everyday reality of the people who experienced it.







Güzel particularly valued the character's ability to express Kurdish politics and social life in his own language. He also believes that this aspect of his cartoons contributed to his prosecution and imprisonment: "Keko was a character who could speak about Kurdish politics and social reality in his own language without being ashamed of himself. At the time, it was unusual to portray Kurdish political experiences, the struggle and everyday life so naturally. Newspapers featured harsher, more rigid drawings with explicit political messages. But portraying our experiences from within, sincerely and as an ordinary part of everyday life, had a different impact. For us, these experiences were already a natural part of life.




What Keko did was make a reality portrayed from the outside as frightening or dangerous visible in its natural form. I believe this approach was also a factor behind my prosecution and imprisonment over these works."




Cartoons on trial




Doğan Güzel was prosecuted in 1993 over the Qırıx cartoon strips he drew for Özgür Gündem. He was charged under Article 159 of the Turkish Penal Code in force at the time and sentenced to a total of 40 months in prison in 1998. Güzel was imprisoned on 31 July 1998 and released on 16 September 1999. That same year, he received the Courage in Editorial Cartooning Award from Cartoonists Rights Network International.




Güzel's experiences became one example of the repression of the Kurdish press and freedom of expression in the field of cartooning. In his account, the underlying issue was his approach to portraying Kurdish experiences naturally, within the context of everyday life.







From Pîne to Zrîng




Güzel continued producing work for different publications after Qırıx. Pîne magazine, which began publication in 1999, marked a new period in Kurdish-language humor and continued until 2002. Years later, in 2019, Zrîng, edited by Doğan Güzel and İmam Cici, began publication. The magazine was planned to appear in two separate editions, in Kurmanji and Kirmanjki.




These publications were part of an effort not only to sustain Kurdish-language humor but also to create opportunities for new cartoonists and stories. However, the future of written humor depended not only on publishing conditions but also on the development of reading habits and the wider use of Kurdish as a written language.




Güzel said that he does not follow contemporary Kurdish-language humor very closely, although he has seen work produced on platforms such as YouTube: "Sometimes amateur productions can be of higher quality than work created with professional equipment and resources. This development was natural, and I believe even better work will emerge. In this sense, we continue to learn and develop."




Güzel believes that the relationship between cartoons and written language is both one of the art form's defining characteristics and a challenge for written culture. He said that the decline of humor magazines has also affected Kurdish-language publications, emphasizing the need to develop the written use of Kurdish and reading habits: "An important characteristic of cartoons is that they exist alongside writing. The combination of drawings and words in humor distinguishes it from other forms of expression. However, its dependence on written culture also creates difficulties. Today, humor magazines are declining not only in Kurdistan but throughout the world.




In Turkey, magazines have closed one after another. It is impossible for this not to affect Kurdish-language humor. But there is another issue concerning Kurdish: the need to develop its written use and a culture of reading. Kurdish needs to be taught in schools, used as a written language and made more widespread. For people to engage with written humor, they need to have developed reading habits to some extent. Although this presents a challenge, it also offers an important opportunity. Cartoons and comics can help encourage people to start reading in Kurdish."




Continuing to draw in exile




The legal cases and pressure Güzel faced also changed the course of his life. He applied for political asylum in Spain in 2012 and subsequently obtained Spanish citizenship. He continued producing work for the Kurdish press while living in Europe.




Exile, however, did not erase Diyarbakır from Güzel's drawings. The city remained present in his work as a world where language, characters and collective memory came together.




Detained again




Doğan Güzel was among the journalists detained during a police operation against the Özgür Gündem newspaper on 17 August 2016. A photograph showing his torn shirt as police took him away during the raid on the newspaper's offices became one of the symbols of repression against the press. Güzel and the other journalists were released two days later.




Güzel, who had been imprisoned years earlier over his cartoons, was now detained outside the newspaper where he worked. The incident showed how questions of press freedom and freedom of expression had resurfaced at different stages of his life.




Bajar: Comics to encourage reading in Kurdish




One of the latest chapters in Güzel's artistic journey is Bajar magazine, which began publication in 2026. The Kurdish-language cartoon and comic magazine, produced under the auspices of Diyarbakır Metropolitan Municipality, is edited by Doğan Güzel and İmam Cici. The first issue of the magazine, published in Kurmanji, was introduced in June 2026. It aims to support the practical use of Kurdish and encourage children to begin reading in the language.




Güzel emphasized that the idea behind Bajar was to establish a mutually supportive relationship between Kurdish and publishing: "We thought that publishing the magazine only in Turkish would limit our ability to reach readers. Instead, we wanted to establish a reciprocal relationship with Kurdish and the language itself. Our aim was to create a publication that could contribute to the written use of Kurdish and help people learn the language through reading. That was why we launched Bajar. The magazine is currently published every two months and consists of 24 pages.




I believe this is a project that can be developed further in the coming period. If Kurdish-language education becomes more widespread in schools and courses, publications of this kind could once again play an important role. The magazine contributes to the development of Kurdish while also drawing strength from the language's continued existence and development. I consider this mutually beneficial relationship important."




Bajar takes the aspirations behind Güzel's earlier publishing experiences into a new field. The cartoons that spoke from within everyday life and political transformation in the world of Qırıx took on new forms in Kurdish-language humor magazines through Pîne and Zrîng. Bajar, meanwhile, approaches comics as a means of helping children develop reading habits in their mother tongue.




Why is Qırıx still remembered?




Qırıx is remembered decades later not simply because he was a humorous character. He portrayed the youth of the 1990s, Diyarbakır's neighborhood culture and the political atmosphere of the period through everyday life. Young people's uncertainties, social transformation and their changing relationship with politics were central elements of the cartoons.




The character reached new generations when Diyarbakır City Theatre brought Qırıx to the stage in 2017. Moving from newspaper pages to the theater, the character found a new form of storytelling.




Güzel's work was not limited to a single character. The artist, who portrayed the youth, everyday life and social contradictions of the 1990s through Qırıx, continued his work in Kurdish-language humor in subsequent years through publications such as Pîne and Zrîng.




Bajar carries this legacy forward through a new publishing approach aimed at helping children develop the habit of reading in Kurdish.




The memory carried by cartoons




Qırıx portrayed the young people of his time, Diyarbakır's neighborhood culture and its political atmosphere through everyday life. The character's adaptation for the theater years later also demonstrated that his story had not remained confined to newspaper pages but could reach new generations in different forms.




Pîne and Zrîng represent different periods of Güzel's work in Kurdish-language humor, while Bajar approaches cartoons and comics as tools that can encourage children to read and write in their mother tongue. Güzel's artistic journey therefore encompasses not only a cartoonist's decades of work but also an effort to give Kurdish a greater place in everyday life through humor and publishing.




The journey from Qırıx, which portrayed the youth and contradictions of an era in newspaper pages, to Bajar, which aims to encourage children to enjoy reading in Kurdish, reflects a change in both the audience and the purpose of the cartoons. Yet the effort to tell stories through drawings, document lived experiences and create space for the written use of Kurdish continues to connect the different periods of Güzel's work.

title: Zidane'dan Mbappe açıklaması: Türkiye maçında oynayabilecek mi?
content:
Fotoğraf: Кирилл Венедиктов/Wikimedia Commons CC BY-SA 3.0

Fransa A Milli Futbol Takımı Teknik Direktörü Zinedine Zidane ve futbolcu Lucas Da Cunha, yarın Türkiye ile oynanacak kritik karşılaşma öncesinde Bordeaux şehrindeki Matmut Atlantique Stadı'nda basın toplantısı düzenledi. İtalya deplasmanında mağlup olduklarını hatırlatan Zidane, yarın sahadan galibiyetle ayrılmaktan başka düşünceleri olmadığını vurguladı.

Üst tura yükselmek için kazanmak zorunda olduklarının altını çizen Fransız teknik direktör, "Türkiye yarın bize zorluk çıkaracak. Buna çok dikkat etmeliyiz. Fransa olarak iyi bir maç ortaya koymalıyız" dedi. İtalya maçında yedikleri 3 golün savunmanın zayıflığından kaynaklanmadığını ifade eden Zidane, milli takımlarda antrenman yapmaya vakit bulamadıklarını, belirli bir oyun felsefeleri olduğunu ve tek amaçlarının üst tura çıkmak olduğunu belirtti.

Basın toplantısında en çok merak edilen konuların başında gelen Kylian Mbappe'nin sakatlık durumuna da değinen Zidane, yıldız oyuncunun herhangi bir problemi bulunmadığını ve yarın Türkiye karşısında forma giyebilecek durumda olduğunu açıkladı.

Toplantıya katılan futbolcu Lucas Da Cunha ise teknik direktörünün kendisine duyduğu güvenden duyduğu memnuniyeti dile getirerek, tek hedeflerinin sahadan galibiyetle ayrılmak olduğunu söyledi.

31 yıldır emeğin sesi olan Evrensel, gücünü sadece okurlarından alıyor. Emeğin sesinin daha gür çıkması için sen de güç ver.

author: Natália Perez
title: Bolsonarismo além da presidência: “Extrema direita não sai derrotada”, avalia especialista
content:
Desde o dia seguinte à derrota de Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) nas eleições presidenciais de 2026, o senador da República segue morando nos Estados Unidos, para onde fugiu após o ministro Alexandre de Moraes determinar a entrega de seus passaportes – o mesmo caminho do irmão e ex-deputado Eduardo Bolsonaro, no ano anterior, também para evitar os inquéritos dos quais são alvo na Justiça.




Nos EUA, os Bolsonaros buscam a proximidade com Donald Trump e seu entorno político. Mas a recente derrota dos republicanos nas eleições legislativas de meio de mandato pode representar um enfraquecimento da extrema direita defendida por essas figuras políticas?

 Este é o tema do 

Pauta Pública

 desta semana que recebe Odilon Caldeira Neto, historiador, professor da Universidade Federal de Juiz de Fora (UFJF) e coordenador do Observatório da Extrema Direita. Para ele, “a despeito da imensa vitória que foi a reeleição do presidente Lula, o campo da extrema direita brasileira não sai derrotado”.




Na conversa com Andrea Dip, ele também analisa os desafios do campo progressista para os próximos anos. “O processo que culminou nas mobilizações para a eleição de Lula não é o ponto final, na verdade são pontos de partida […] assim como a direita criou uma nova geração a partir das mobilizações das ruas, a partir das formas de pulverização e de atuação na sociedade, as esquerdas também precisam pensar a partir dessa realidade ou, se não, essas conquistas muito importantes podem ser espécies de respiros, podem ser ganhos pontuais”, afirma.




Leia os principais pontos da conversa e ouça o podcast completo abaixo.























































EP 242


											O início do fim do bolsonarismo? — com Odilon Caldeira Neto							













13 de novembro de 2026


					·
				


				Historiador reflete sobre os rumos da extrema direita e os desafios do campo progressista

Veja mais episódios desta série










Após a fuga e as cartas atrapalhadas de Flávio, as três versões delas, qual análise pode ser feita sobre as reconfigurações do bolsonarismo e como a figura do Tarcísio se encaixa nesse momento?




Existe um espólio em disputa no campo bolsonarista que se configura de diversas maneiras, inclusive intrafamiliar. O caso de Eduardo Bolsonaro e o caso de Flávio Bolsonaro trazem consigo alguma espécie de capital, mas distantes do cenário político brasileiro.

 É interessante focar a análise nas figuras que vão, em certa medida, buscar articular atores e atrizes – atrizes, justamente, pela presença da Michele Bolsonaro –, e talvez um ator do campo bolsonarista familiar, o Carlos Bolsonaro. Agora, Carlos assumiu posição de um certo protagonismo, tendo visitado o pai na prisão domiciliar, em sua residência, ele tem sido uma espécie de interlocutor.




Porém, a figura de Michelle Bolsonaro não pode ser menosprezada de maneira alguma, por várias razões: da capacidade política à forma como ela liderou até recentemente o PL Mulher, a forma como ela integra setores eleitoralmente muito interessantes, com relação aos setores do conservadorismo evangélico, de um voto feminino que é sempre um gargalo para a extrema direita brasileira. Então, sem dúvida alguma, a Michelle é uma atriz de fundamental importância.




Inclusive, o campo bolsonarista tem manifestado, de maneira crescente, espécies de reações à figura de Michelle. Tem sido muito comum a referência à utilização de outros sobrenomes atribuídos à Michelle, que não o Bolsonaro, ou seja, existe uma tensão familiar, que pode ser resolvida dependendo da capacidade política de Michelle Bolsonaro.




Um campo que ainda há de se configurar, mas tem um elemento importante de situar que é o desejo de reflexões e de mudanças no caráter da prisão de Jair Bolsonaro, ou seja, mais uma vez a questão da anistia.

 O quadro de Jair Bolsonaro lida ainda um pouco com a questão, não somente da tensão entre o STF e o campo bolsonarista, mas também pela configuração da Câmara e do Senado.




Por outro lado, existe um campo de disputa da juventude de extrema direita que tem sido mobilizado nas últimas semanas pelo partido Missão. Renan Santos conseguiu articular bem um certo domínio do cenário das redes nas últimas semanas, inclusive, da forma um tanto ambivalente ou paradoxal que ele se colocou ao longo do segundo turno.




Outro cenário é o campo dos mais jovens eleitos nesse dado momento. A figura do Pavanato parece uma figura importante e, claro, a Eduarda Campopiano. É claro que tanto Pavanato quanto Eduarda Campopiano saem um pouco machucados deste processo da eleição de Lula, mas ainda assim, saíram em alguma medida vitoriosos no processo da eleição da Câmara e do Senado. Então, existe um campo em disputa que convém considerar muitas dessas figuras jovens do campo bolsonarista.




Por fim, fica a figura de Tarcísio, que tem como desafio talvez pensar uma articulação com Michelle Bolsonaro. Não sei se será feito, mas à primeira vista parece uma saída.

 A articulação com Carlos Bolsonaro não parece uma questão muito capaz de ser concretizada, porque diz respeito às estratégias e a natureza política de Carlos Bolsonaro. Já a juventude, acredito, há de ser eventualmente mobilizada por Tarcísio, até porque muitas dessas figuras não têm sequer idade para serem alçadas à candidatura presidencial. 




Então, Tarcísio tem um desafio pela frente. Não me parece muito clara a forma como esse campo, que denominamos até dado momento de bolsonarismo, vai se consolidar. Inclusive, é importante, analiticamente falando, olharmos esse quadro a partir daquilo que esses fenômenos: o fato é que são figuras, lideranças, representantes da extrema direita brasileira.




Quais são os perigos reais que a extrema direita ainda apresenta, inclusive na juventude, pensando na candidatura de Renan Santos e nas votações expressivas de Nikolas Ferreira. Eles são de fato uma ameaça?

Renan Santos tem uma capacidade de oratória muito interessante. Tem um certo carisma na forma como ele se comunica, mas estruturalmente falando, do ponto de vista da sua legenda partidária e capacidade de criar pontes – que na política é uma questão de fundamental importância –, Renan Santos não demonstra muita disposição.




O 

Partido Missão

 é um projeto que almeja uma longa duração em dois termos: longa duração do projeto que busca construir e também de um eventual e hipotético sucesso que talvez tarde a acontecer.

 Um processo que concretize uma cultura de extrema direita, inclusive com viabilidade política além da efemeridade do campo institucional.




Nesse sentido, do ponto de vista de um projeto político, o Partido Missão é muito ambicioso. Não me parece, nesse dado momento, que ele consiga, mas o estilo comunicacional que tem sido colocado em prática tem suscitado não apenas uma boa indústria de takes e de cortes, mas vejo que o discurso de Renan Santos tem se tornado muito palatável.




É um ponto inicial importante a considerar: existe um projeto aqui sendo colocado, existe um projeto que é parte deste universo do extremismo de direita e pode render frutos. Agora, nesse contexto, a figura do Nikolas Ferreira é uma figura de liderança muito grande, muito forte no cenário bolsonarista. É claro, parte disso é consolidado a partir da forma de aliança das big techs com o cenário da extrema direita global e particularmente brasileira.




Mas mesmo diante disso, não podemos desconsiderar a quantidade de votos que o Nikolas teve: foram mais de 3 milhões de votos, não é algo a se desconsiderar. 

Agora, embora seja uma liderança proeminente, não me parece que nesse dado momento Nikolas Ferreira tenha capacidade de articulação central do campo bolsonarista.




Talvez seja uma estratégia que ele vá colocar em prática a partir desse mandato. Ou seja, se descolar um pouco da eterna indústria de códigos, de vídeo, de reacts, para se transformar, efetivamente, em um formulador para a extrema direita brasileira. Mas o problema do Nikolas é que ele terá de lidar com as disputas do campo bolsonarista. É uma espada de dois gumes. Por um lado, Renan tem uma grande capacidade e um campo, onde ele consegue conceber uma ideia de pureza ideológica, mas que é limitado. Por outro lado, o Nikolas Ferreira tem uma máquina muito grande, mas não adquire espaço de centralidade.




O mais importante é considerar que a despeito da imensa vitória que foi a reeleição do presidente Lula, 

o campo da extrema direita brasileira não saiu derrotado. Ele saiu efetivamente fortalecido e demonstra que figuras que estavam no segundo escalão podem subir para o primeiro escalão.

 Já as figuras que estavam ali na liderança dentro do rol da família Bolsonaro podem dar lugar às novas figuras. E o mais preocupante é que esse cenário continua a ser normalizado, naturalizado por parcelas significativas das elites brasileiras e parcelas significativas da imprensa hegemônica brasileira, ou seja, o problema não está solucionado.




Além do Brasil, nas midterms nos Estados Unidos, Netanyahu aparentemente enfraquecido em Israel e outros exemplos pelo mundo, parece que temos um momento novo de enfraquecimento da extrema direita. Mas olhando, por exemplo, o Congresso Brasileiro tomado pelo PL ou os democratas nos Estados Unidos, que tiveram uma grande vitória mas ainda vão ter que lidar com o Trump na presidência, Israel ainda tenta formar coalizões, Alemanha enfrentando várias questões para manter o cordão sanitário com relação à AFD nas últimas eleições. Como podemos analisar esse momento mundialmente? Entramos, de fato, em um novo momento de perdas para a direita? E, se sim, o que causou esse desgaste?




É um pouco apressado, ao meu ver, afirmar que o momento, realmente, é o fim e o esgotamento de um ciclo político. A gente pensa na realidade brasileira, mas sem dúvida alguma, colocando isso em uma perspectiva global, ainda vivemos um ciclo ou de hegemonia ou de dominação de parcelas significativas das direitas e, particularmente, da extrema direita no cenário político global.

 Não é uma tentativa de desmerecer o que foi a eleição de Lula, o resultado nos Estados Unidos ou mesmo a possibilidade daquilo que pode acontecer nas próximas semanas no Paraguai, por exemplo.




Sem dúvida alguma, existe uma certa crise do modelo da extrema direita, existe uma certa limitação do processo político, mas acredito ser ainda muito apressado dizer que esse ciclo se esgotou, por diversas razões, seja por questões das lideranças que ainda existem, seja pela maneira como determinadas conquistas foram colocadas em prática por esse campo, seja para a dimensão da política atribuída ou mesmo colocada em prática pelas principais big techs, como elas assumiram contorno político.




Também é importante considerar que os frutos dessas conquistas se transformam em uma nova geração que foi moldada a partir dessas questões. Então, não podemos olhar a política apenas do processo eleitoral em si, fenômenos político-eleitorais são baseados a partir de grandes processos históricos, nos quais os indivíduos são uma força de fundamental importância, inclusive do ponto de vista da produção e reprodução desses valores intrínsecos às determinadas correntes político-ideológicas.




Em contrapartida, não podemos desmerecer de maneira alguma o que foi uma certa revolução democrática – como alguns autores colocaram a partir da eleição de Lula –, por exemplo, com o “janonismo” que foi colocado e tem tido até uma tentativa de adaptação e  reprodução a partir da realidade de outros países, e de um fator ainda de maior importância que foi a volta das esquerdas às ruas.




Não somente no campo brasileiro, a volta das esquerdas às ruas demonstra também que é possível, a despeito desses congressos e senado, na particularidade brasileira é possível pensar saídas à esquerda a partir da mobilização não contínua, mas em momentos adversos ou estratégicos do campo progressista. E parece que o presidente Lula leu perfeitamente isso, inclusive disse em pronunciamento que é necessário contar com aqueles que participaram desse grande evento para os próximos quatro anos. 

Não serão quatro anos fáceis, longe disso, mas a saída à esquerda, inclusive, do ponto de vista da campanha de Lula, necessitava radicalizar sua proposta e seguir em diante.




Ou seja, quando passamos por grandes eventos, evidentemente, os grandes eventos ficam mais ou menos cristalizados e se tornam um pouco patrimônios da nossa memória coletiva na atualidade, mas o processo que culminou nas mobilizações para a eleição de Lula não é o ponto final, na verdade, são pontos de partida.

title: Fransa-Türkiye maçı ne zaman, saat kaçta, hangi kanalda?
content:
A Milli Futbol Takımı, UEFA Uluslar A Ligi 1. Grup'taki altıncı ve son maçında Fransa'ya konuk olacak. Bordeaux kentindeki Matmut Atlantique Stadı'nda oynanacak karşılaşma saat 22.45'te başlayacak. Mücadeleyi İngiltere Futbol Federasyonundan hakem Chris Kavanagh yönetecek.

A Ligi'nde oynadığı ilk 5 maçta puan alamayan Türkiye, grupta son sırada bulunuyor. Türkiye İtalya'ya Bursa'da 4-1, deplasmanda Belçika'ya 3-0, Bologna'da İtalya'ya 3-1 ve İzmir'de Belçika'ya 2-1 mağlup oldu.

İki takım grubun ilk maçında Kocaeli Stadı'nda karşı karşıya gelmiş, Fransa mücadeleyi Kylian Mbappe'nin golüyle 1-0 kazanmıştı. Türkiye ile Fransa bugüne kadar 7 kez karşılaştı. Bu maçların 5'ini Fransa kazanırken Türkiye 1 galibiyet elde etti, 1 karşılaşma ise beraberlikle sonuçlandı. Söz konusu maçlarda Fransa 14, Türkiye 5 gol kaydetti.

Türkiye, gruptaki 5 maçını da kaybetmesine rağmen A Ligi'nde kalma ihtimalini koruyor. A Ligi'ndeki dört grubun son sırasında yer alan takımlardan puan ve averaj bakımından en kötü durumda olan ikisi doğrudan B Ligi'ne düşecek. Diğer iki takım ise B Ligi'nden gelecek takımlarla play-off oynayacak.

Kart cezası sona eren Abdülkerim Bardakcı, Fransa karşısında forma giyebilecek. Belçika maçında gördüğü kart nedeniyle cezalı duruma düşen Ozan Kabak ise karşılaşmada görev alamayacak.

Fransa: Maignan, Gusto, Konate, Jacquet, Truffert, Rabiot, Da Cunha, Cherki, Doue, Olise, Barcola.

Türkiye: Uğurcan, Zeki, Merih, Abdülkerim, Ferdi, Salih, Orkun, Arda, Yunus, Barış Alper, Enes.

author: Unknown
title: Rusya'dan açıklama: 'Ukrayna'nın enerji, liman ve demir yolu altyapı tesislerini vurduk'
content:
Görseller: Pixabay | Kolaj: Evrensel

Rusya Savunma Bakanlığı, Ukrayna'daki eylemlerine ilişkin açıklama yaparak ülkedeki kritik altyapı tesislerinin hedef aldıklarını duyurdu.

Bakanlıktan yapılan açıklamada, Rus ordusunun gece saatlerinde askeri amaçla kullanılan enerji, liman ve demir yolu altyapı tesislerine saldırı düzenlediği belirtilerek şu ifadelere yer verildi:

"Rivne bölgesinde Ukrayna ordusu için kullanılan lojistik tesislerinin çalışmalarını sağlayan trafo merkezi, Odessa bölgesindeki Çornomorsk Limanı'nda feribot terminali ve trafo merkezi ile Dnipropetrovsk kentindeki bir tren istasyonu yakınlarında iki lokomotif vuruldu."

Saldırıların insansız hava araçları (İHA) kullanılarak gerçekleştirildiği aktarılan açıklamada, Karadeniz'de askeri yükler taşıyan bir geminin de hedef alındığı kaydedildi. Öte yandan açıklamada, gece boyunca Ukrayna'ya ait 533 İHA'nın çeşitli bölgeler üzerinde hava savunma sistemleri tarafından düşürüldüğü de belirtildi.

author: Unknown
title: AKP ilçe başkanıyla görüşmeyen ilçe sağlık müdürüne "istifa" baskısı iddiası
content:
Rize – Pazar İlçe Sağlık Müdürlüğü görevinden alınan İ.Ö'nün, AKP Pazar İlçe Başkanı Furkan Namlı’nın ziyaret talebini kabul etmediği gerekçesiyle geçen günlerde istifaya zorlandığı iddia edildi. Yeni Parti Rize İl Başkanı Saltuk Deniz, İ.Ö'nün görevine iadesini isteyerek, AKP yetkililerine “Kurum amirleri sizin hizmetkârınız değildir” dedi.

Edinilen bilgilere göre, 4 Ağustos 2026 tarihinde AKP Pazar İlçe Başkanı olan Furkan Namlı ve beraberindeki yönetim kurulu üyeleri, kurum ziyaretleri kapsamında Pazar İlçe Sağlık Müdürlüğü’nden telefonla randevu talep etti. İlçe Sağlık Müdürü Dr. İ.Ö’nün ilk talebin ardından müsait olmadığını belirttiği, ikinci telefon görüşmesinde ise 657 sayılı Devlet Memurları Kanunu’na tabi bir kamu görevlisi olduğunu ifade ederek siyasi parti ilçe başkanlarıyla makamında görüşmeyeceğini bildirdiği ileri sürüldü.

Rize'deki AKP yetkililerince bunun İl Sağlık Müdürü Prof. Dr. Gökhan Demiral’a ileterek Dr. İ.Ö’nün görevden alınmasını ya da istifa etmesinin istendiği, bunun ardından Dr. İ.Ö’ye istifa etmesi yönünde telkinde bulunulduğu ancak ilçe sağlık müdürünün bunu kabul etmediği savunuldu.

Dr. İ.Ö. bir süre sonra ise İlçe Sağlık Müdürlüğü'nden alındı.

Pazar İlçe Sağlık Müdürlüğü çalışanları da Dr. İ.Ö’ye istifa etmesi yönünde baskı yapıldığını ifade etti.

Yeni Parti Rize İl Başkanı Saltuk Deniz, Dr. İ.Ö’nün Pazar İlçe Sağlık Müdürlüğü'nden alınmasına tepki gösterdi. Kamu kurumlarında görev yapan yöneticilerin siyasi parti temsilcilerinin hizmetinde olmadığını vurgulayan Deniz, şu açıklamayı yaptı:

“Devlet kurumlarında çalışan görevlilerimiz siyasi parti temsilcilerinin hizmetkârı değillerdir. Kurum amirleri, hiçbir siyasi parti temsilcisi ile görevleri dışında görüşmek zorunda değildir. Daha önce de benzeri olaylar ilimizde yaşanmıştı. Rize İl Milli Eğitim Müdürü Halil İbrahim Akmeşe de İl Milli Eğitim Müdürlüğü görevine atanır atanmaz, daha koltuğuna oturmadan soluğu AKP İl Başkanlığı’nda aldı. Bunlar doğru şeyler değildir. Kurum amirleri sizlerin hizmetkârı değildir. Rahat bırakın çalışanları. Kurumlarda iş barışını bozmanın, amirleri ve memurları siyasal gücünüzü kullanarak görevlerinden almak ya da uzaklaştırmakla diğer kurum çalışanlarına gözdağı vermenin siyasi ahlakla da bağdaşmadığını düşünüyoruz. AKP sözcülerini ve İl Sağlık Müdürlüğü’nü bu konuyla ilgili açıklama yapmalarını, görevinden alınan doktorumuzun yeniden görevine iade edilmesini kamuoyu adına talep ediyoruz.”
